```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
RUN_NETWORK <- FALSE

RESAMPLE_N <- 50

DIRS <- c(raw     = "00_inputs",
          meta    = "01_metadata",

  for (k in to_wipe) unlink(file.path(out_dir, DIRS[k]), recursive = TRUE)
  message("WIPE_OUTPUTS: cleared ", paste(DIRS[to_wipe], collapse = ", "))
}
for (d in DIRS) dir.create(file.path(out_dir, d), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

p_raw  <- function(...) file.path(out_dir, DIRS["raw"],     ...)
p_meta <- function(...) file.path(out_dir, DIRS["meta"],    ...)
p_ps   <- function(...) file.path(out_dir, DIRS["ps"],      ...)
p_ml   <- function(...) file.path(out_dir, DIRS["maaslin"], ...)
p_sd   <- function(...) file.path(out_dir, DIRS["sd"],      ...)
p_fig  <- function(...) file.path(out_dir, DIRS["fig"],     ...)
p_net  <- function(...) file.path(out_dir, DIRS["net"],     ...)

# Every input is read from 00_inputs. Nothing is read from anywhere else.
p_raw_req <- function(name) {
  p <- p_raw(name)
  if (!file.exists(p)) stop(name, " is not in ", p_raw(""))
  p
}

maaslin_path <- function(name) {
  p <- p_ml(name)
  if (!file.exists(p))
    stop(name, " is not in ", p_ml(""), ". Set REFIT_MAASLIN <- TRUE.")
  p
}

net_path <- function(name) {
  p <- p_net(name)
  if (!file.exists(p))
    stop(name, " is not in ", p_net(""), ". Set RUN_NETWORK <- TRUE.")
  p
}

# Orientation-agnostic sample x feature matrix.
sample_matrix <- function(ps) {
  m <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) m <- t(m)
  as.data.frame(m)
}

add_effect_size <- function(df) {
  dplyr::mutate(df,
    CI_lower = coef - 1.96 * stderr,
    CI_upper = coef + 1.96 * stderr,
    evidence = dplyr::case_when(
      qval < 0.05 ~ "Confirmatory (FDR < 0.05)",
      qval < 0.10 ~ "Suggestive (FDR < 0.10)",
      pval < 0.05 ~ "Exploratory (nominal P < 0.05 only)",
      TRUE        ~ "Not selected"))
}

fdr_summary <- function(res, model_label) {
  res$results |>
    dplyr::group_by(predictor = metadata) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_tested  = dplyr::n(),
      p_lt_0.05 = sum(pval < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      q_lt_0.05 = sum(qval < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      q_lt_0.10 = sum(qval < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
      q_lt_0.25 = sum(qval < 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_qval  = min(qval, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups   = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(model = model_label, .before = 1)
}

read_maaslin <- function(path, id_col = "feature", fix_spruce = FALSE) {
  r <- readRDS(path)$results |> dplyr::rename(!!id_col := 1)
  if (fix_spruce)
    r[[id_col]] <- gsub("(SPRUCE)\\.(\\d+)", "\\1 \\2", r[[id_col]])
  add_effect_size(r)
}

tidy_glmmtmb <- function(model, response) {
  cf <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)
  colnames(cf) <- c("Estimate", "Std_Error", "z_value", "p_value")
  cf$term <- rownames(cf); rownames(cf) <- NULL
  r2 <- suppressWarnings(try(r.squaredGLMM(model), silent = TRUE))
  ok <- !inherits(r2, "try-error")
  singular <- any(is.nan(cf$Std_Error))
  data.frame(
    response       = response,
    formula        = paste(deparse(formula(model)), collapse = " "),
    n              = nobs(model),
    cf,
    sig            = dplyr::case_when(cf$p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                      cf$p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                                      cf$p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                                      cf$p_value < 0.1   ~ ".", TRUE ~ ""),
    R2_marginal    = if (ok) round(r2[1, "R2m"], 3) else NA_real_,
    R2_conditional = if (ok) round(r2[1, "R2c"], 3) else NA_real_,
    singular_fit   = singular,
    row.names      = NULL)
}

# Refit without (1|Plot) when its variance is ~0 and the standard errors are NaN.
drop_singular_re <- function(model, data, label) {
  sd_plot <- tryCatch(attr(VarCorr(model)$cond$Plot, "stddev")[1],
                      error = function(e) NA_real_)
  nan_se  <- any(is.nan(as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)$`Std. Error`))
  if (isTRUE(nan_se) || (!is.na(sd_plot) && sd_plot < 0.01)) {
    f <- as.formula(gsub("\\s*\\+\\s*\\(1\\s*\\|\\s*Plot\\)", "",
                         paste(deparse(formula(model)), collapse = " ")))
    message(label, ": (1|Plot) variance is ~0 (sd = ", signif(sd_plot, 3),
            "). Refitting without the random effect.")
    return(list(model = glmmTMB(f, data = data, family = family(model)),
                dropped_re = TRUE))
  }
  list(model = model, dropped_re = FALSE)
}

# Keep the interaction only if the LRT supports it.
lrt_interaction <- function(f_full, f_noint, data, family = gaussian(), label = "") {
  m_full  <- glmmTMB(f_full,  data = data, family = family)
  m_noint <- glmmTMB(f_noint, data = data, family = family)
  p <- anova(m_full, m_noint)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  keep <- !is.na(p) && p < 0.05
  message(label, ": interaction LRT P = ", signif(p, 3),
          if (keep) " -> retained" else " -> dropped")
  list(model = if (keep) m_full else m_noint, lrt_p = p, retained = keep)
}

# Shared Maaslin2 configuration: prevalence and abundance filtering inside the
# model, no internal normalisation.
# `transform` is passed through to Maaslin2. Its default there is "LOG", which is
# right for count-like inputs but wrong for the metabolites: those are supplied
# already log2 transformed, so leaving the default applies a second log. The
# metabolite call therefore passes transform = "NONE". Every other model keeps
# "LOG" unless and until its input is shown to be pre-transformed; the value
# range printed below is the diagnostic for that.
fit_maaslin <- function(ps, name, fixed, random = "Plot", features = NULL,
                        min_prev = MIN_PREVALENCE, min_abun = MIN_ABUNDANCE,
                        transform = "LOG") {
  dat <- sample_matrix(ps)
  if (!is.null(features)) dat <- dat[, intersect(features, colnames(dat)), drop = FALSE]
  meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  stopifnot(setequal(rownames(dat), rownames(meta)))
  miss <- setdiff(c(fixed, random), names(meta))
  if (length(miss))
    stop(name, ": predictor(s) not in sample_data: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
         "\n  available: ", paste(sort(names(meta)), collapse = ", "))
  allna <- c(fixed, random)[vapply(c(fixed, random),
                                   \(v) all(is.na(meta[[v]])), logical(1))]
  if (length(allna))
    stop(name, ": predictor(s) present but entirely NA: ",
         paste(allna, collapse = ", "))

  kept <- sum(colMeans(dat > min_abun, na.rm = TRUE) >= min_prev)
  message(sprintf("%s: %d samples, %d features, %d pass prevalence >= %.2f (%d dropped)",
                  name, nrow(dat), ncol(dat), kept, min_prev, ncol(dat) - kept))

  # An input with no zeros and a narrow total range has already been log
  # transformed upstream, in which case transform = "LOG" applies a second one.
  rng <- range(dat, na.rm = TRUE); nz <- sum(dat == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  message(sprintf("  %s: range %.4g to %.4g, %d zeros, transform = %s",
                  name, rng[1], rng[2], nz, transform))
  if (nz == 0 && rng[1] > 0 && rng[2] / rng[1] < 100 && transform == "LOG")
    warning(name, ": input has no zeros and only a ", signif(rng[2] / rng[1], 3),
            "-fold total range, so it looks already log transformed, but ",
            "transform = \"LOG\" will log it again. Pass transform = \"NONE\" ",
            "if that is the case.")

  chr_sig <- function(x) sum(utf8ToInt(paste0(x, collapse = "")))
  sig <- list(
    fixed = fixed, random = random, min_prev = min_prev, min_abun = min_abun,
    transform = transform,
    dims = dim(dat),
    names = c(chr_sig(rownames(dat)), chr_sig(colnames(dat))),
    values = c(sum(dat, na.rm = TRUE), sum(dat^2, na.rm = TRUE), sum(is.na(dat))),
    predictors = vapply(c(fixed, random), function(v) {
      x <- meta[rownames(dat), v]
      if (is.numeric(x)) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE) else chr_sig(as.character(x))
    }, numeric(1)))

  rds  <- p_ml(paste0(name, ".rds"))
  sigf <- p_ml(paste0(name, ".signature.rds"))
  if (isTRUE(MAASLIN_CACHE) && file.exists(rds) && file.exists(sigf) &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(readRDS(sigf), sig))) {
    message("  ", name, ": cached fit matches these inputs, skipping refit.")
    return(invisible(readRDS(rds)))
  }

  m <- Maaslin2(
    input_data = dat, input_metadata = meta[rownames(dat), , drop = FALSE],
    min_abundance = min_abun, min_prevalence = min_prev, normalization = "NONE",
    transform = transform,
    output = p_ml(name), fixed_effects = fixed, random_effects = random)
  saveRDS(m, rds)
  saveRDS(sig, sigf)
  invisible(m)
}

MODEL_TABLE <- list()
FILE_LOG    <- character(0)
register_model <- function(x) { MODEL_TABLE[[length(MODEL_TABLE) + 1]] <<- x; invisible(x) }
write_out <- function(x, path, ...) {
  readr::write_csv(x, path, ...)
  FILE_LOG <<- c(FILE_LOG, path)
  message("wrote ", path, "  (", nrow(x), " rows)")
  invisible(x)
}
save_fig <- function(plot, path, ...) {
  ggsave(path, plot, ...)
  FILE_LOG <<- c(FILE_LOG, path)
  invisible(path)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Metabolite feature-ID parsing and annotation-name bookkeeping.
#
# Feature IDs are "<acquisition mode>_<retention time, min>_<precursor m/z>",
# e.g. "RP_6.745_275.15998". Splitting them into their own columns lets a reader
# judge whether two features carrying the same compound name are isomers,
# adducts or redundant assignments.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

parse_feature_id <- function(feature) {
  m   <- stringr::str_match(feature, "^([A-Za-z]+)_([0-9.]+)_([0-9.]+)$")
  bad <- is.na(m[, 1]) & !is.na(feature)
  if (any(bad))
    warning(sum(bad), " feature ID(s) do not match '<mode>_<RT>_<mz>' and were ",
            "left as NA, e.g. ", paste(utils::head(feature[bad], 3), collapse = ", "))
  data.frame(Acquisition_mode = m[, 2],
             RT_min           = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m[, 3])),
             precursor_mz     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(m[, 4])),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MSI annotation levels
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Annotation sub-levels are mapped onto the standard four-level MSI scheme
# (Rajakaruna et al. 2026, doi:10.1093/ismeco/ycag223): L1 authentic standard;
# L2 mzCloud MS/MS match; L3 computational structure proposal; L4 formula only.
MSI4_MAP <- c(L1 = "L1", L2 = "L2",
              L2.1 = "L3", L2.2 = "L3", L2.3 = "L3",
              L3.1 = "L4", L3.2 = "L4", L3.3 = "L4",
              L3 = "L3", L4 = "L4")   # idempotent: recoding twice is a no-op

to_msi4 <- function(conf) {
  conf <- trimws(as.character(conf))
  conf[conf %in% c("", "NA")] <- NA_character_
  out  <- unname(MSI4_MAP[conf])
  unmapped <- !is.na(conf) & is.na(out)
  if (any(unmapped))
    stop("Annotation_Confidence values with no entry in MSI4_MAP: ",
         paste(sort(unique(conf[unmapped])), collapse = ", "),
         ". Extend MSI4_MAP rather than letting them through as NA.")
  out
}

# A name is an identification claim; L3 and L4 names are the best-matching
# candidate structure. Anything at or below L3, and anything with no level at
# all, is labelled in Figure 3 by compound class and feature ID instead.
MSI_NAMEABLE <- c("L1", "L2")

# Two names for what is one putative assignment. In-silico fragmentation and
# predicted retention time cannot resolve stereochemistry, so the diastereomer
# pair below is reported once, without a stereodescriptor. Matched on Final_name.
NAME_ALIASES <- c(
  "(5R,6S)-5-Hydroxy-4-methoxy-6-(2-phenylethyl)-5,6-dihydro-2H-pyran-2-one" =
    "5-Hydroxy-4-methoxy-6-(2-phenylethyl)-5,6-dihydro-2H-pyran-2-one (stereochemistry unresolved)",
  "(5S,6S)-5-hydroxy-4-methoxy-6-(2-phenylethyl)-5,6-dihydro-2H-pyran-2-one" =
    "5-Hydroxy-4-methoxy-6-(2-phenylethyl)-5,6-dihydro-2H-pyran-2-one (stereochemistry unresolved)")

apply_name_aliases <- function(x) {
  hit <- !is.na(x) & x %in% names(NAME_ALIASES)
  if (any(hit))
    message("name aliases: collapsed ", sum(hit), " feature name(s) onto ",
            length(unique(unname(NAME_ALIASES[x[hit]]))), " assignment(s)")
  x[hit] <- unname(NAME_ALIASES[x[hit]])
  x
}

# Features are never merged. A compound name carried by more than one feature is
# labelled as such and the count travels with it into the supplementary tables,
# so a shared name can be read as what it is rather than as replication.
add_name_multiplicity <- function(df, name_col = "Final_name") {
  nm <- df[[name_col]]
  nm[nm %in% c("", "M", "NA")] <- NA_character_
  n  <- ave(rep(1L, length(nm)), ifelse(is.na(nm), "unnamed", nm), FUN = length)
  df$Name_n_features <- ifelse(is.na(nm), NA_integer_, as.integer(n))
  df$Name_status <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(nm)              ~ "unnamed feature",
    df$Name_n_features > 1 ~ "name shared with other features",
    TRUE                   ~ "name unique to this feature")
  df
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The one place the metabolite phyloseq is read
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The NOSC block, the Maaslin2 block and the network all read the metabolite
# phyloseq through this function, so the same filtered feature set is used
# throughout.
#
# Two transformations happen here and nowhere else:
#
#   1. "M" is the unnamed sentinel in the annotation table, not a
#      compound. Setting it to NA is what filters it: add_name_multiplicity(),
#      the class-level analysis, the NOSC subset and the network all key off a
#      non-missing Final_name.
#   2. Annotation_Confidence is mapped onto the standard four MSI levels.
#      The original value is kept in
#      Annotation_Confidence_sublevel so nothing is lost.
#
# METAB_M_FILTERED and METAB_MSI_CENSUS are written on the first call and read
# back by the reporting code, so the counts quoted in the Methods come from the
# same object the analysis used.
METAB_M_FILTERED <- NA_integer_
METAB_MSI_CENSUS <- NULL

read_metab_ps <- function(quiet = FALSE) {
  ps  <- readRDS(p_raw_req(METAB_PS_FILE))
  tx  <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  n_M <- sum(tx$Final_name %in% "M", na.rm = TRUE)
  tx$Final_name[tx$Final_name %in% c("M", "")] <- NA_character_
  tx$Final_name <- apply_name_aliases(tx$Final_name)

  tx$Annotation_Confidence_sublevel <- tx$Annotation_Confidence
  tx$Annotation_Confidence <- to_msi4(tx$Annotation_Confidence_sublevel)

  census <- as.data.frame(table(
    MSI_level = factor(tx$Annotation_Confidence,
                       levels = c("L1", "L2", "L3", "L4"), exclude = NULL)),
    responseName = "n_features")

  METAB_M_FILTERED <<- n_M
  METAB_MSI_CENSUS <<- census

  if (!quiet) {
    cat(sprintf("Unnamed sentinel: %d feature(s) had Final_name == \"M\", filtered to NA\n",
                n_M))
    cat("\n=== Annotation confidence census, four-level scheme ===\n")
    print(as.data.frame(table(
      old = factor(tx$Annotation_Confidence_sublevel, exclude = NULL),
      new = factor(tx$Annotation_Confidence,          exclude = NULL))) |>
      subset(Freq > 0))
    print(census)
  }

  tax_table(ps) <- as.matrix(tx)
  ps
}

# Legends are written to <name>_legend.pdf rather than placed on the panels, so
# panel aspect ratios stay identical across a multi-panel figure.
save_legend <- function(plot, path, width = 3, height = 4) {
  lg <- try(ggpubr::get_legend(plot + theme(legend.position = "right")),
            silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(lg, "try-error") || is.null(lg)) {
    message("no legend to extract for ", basename(path)); return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  ggsave(path, ggpubr::as_ggplot(lg), width = width, height = height)
  FILE_LOG <<- c(FILE_LOG, path)
  invisible(path)
}

legend_path <- function(path) sub("\\.pdf$", "_legend.pdf", path)

save_fig_nolegend <- function(plot, path, ..., legend_width = 3, legend_height = 4) {
  save_legend(plot, legend_path(path), width = legend_width, height = legend_height)
  save_fig(plot + theme(legend.position = "none"), path, ...)
}
```

## 2. METADATA AND ENVIRONMENTAL MODELS

Primary predictors throughout:

- `Temp_avg_top`   = (AvgTemp10cm + AvgTemp20cm) / 2, May–Aug (°C)
- `WT_drawdown_cm` = positive values are deeper and drier (cm)

```{r load-metadata}

metadata_df <- left_join(
    read.csv(p_raw_req("metadata.csv")),
    read.csv(p_raw_req("Spruce_summer2020-2022_temp_WT_Moisture_MayJuneJulyAugust.csv")) |>
      dplyr::select(-any_of("X")),
    by = c("Plot", "Year")) |>
  mutate(
    Year              = as.factor(Year),
    Plot              = as.factor(Plot),
    Warming           = as.factor(Warming),
    Warming_Treatment = as.factor(Warming_Treatment),
    CO2_Treatment     = as.factor(CO2_Treatment),
    Depth             = as.factor(Depth),
    CO2               = as.factor(CO2),
    Warming_Treatment.ord = forcats::fct_relevel(
      Warming, "0 ºC", "2.25 ºC", "4.5 ºC", "6.75 ºC", "9 ºC"),
    WT_drawdown       = 0 - AvgWTE_normalized,
    WT_drawdown_cm    = WT_drawdown * 100,
    Temp_avg_top      = (AvgTemp10cm + AvgTemp20cm) / 2,
    SoilWater_avg_top = (AvgMoisture0cm + AvgMoisture20cm) / 2)

write_out(metadata_df, p_meta("metadata_df.csv"))
```

## 2.2 WATER TABLE AND MOISTURE MODELS

One observation per enclosure per year, so no random effect. Stepwise AIC.

```{r env-models}

cat("=== Normality checks ===\n")
cat("WT_drawdown_cm: p =", round(shapiro.test(metadata_df$WT_drawdown_cm)$p.value, 3), "\n")
cat("AvgMoisture0cm: p =", round(shapiro.test(metadata_df$AvgMoisture0cm)$p.value, 3), "\n")

step.WTE <- step(glm((WT_drawdown_cm + 100) ~ Temp_avg_top + Temp_avg_top:Year,
                     data = metadata_df, family = Gamma(link = "identity")), trace = 0)
cat("\n===== Water table drawdown (Gamma GLM) =====\n")
cat("Adj R2 =", round(glmtoolbox::adjR2(step.WTE), 3), "\n"); print(summary(step.WTE))

step.moist0 <- step(lm(AvgMoisture0cm ~ Temp_avg_top + Temp_avg_top:Year,
                       data = metadata_df), trace = 0)
cat("\n===== Surface moisture (0 cm) =====\n")
cat("Adj R2 =", round(summary(step.moist0)$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n"); print(summary(step.moist0))

step.moist20 <- step(lm(AvgMoisture20cm ~ Temp_avg_top + Temp_avg_top:Year,
                        data = metadata_df), trace = 0)
cat("\n===== Deep moisture (20 cm) =====\n")
cat("Adj R2 =", round(summary(step.moist20)$adj.r.squared, 3), "\n"); print(summary(step.moist20))
```

## 2.4 MAG TAXONOMY AND CAMPER ANNOTATION

```{r load-mag-annotations}

Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED <- load_genes_ps()
tax_df <- data.frame(tax_table(readRDS(p_raw_req(MAG_ABUNDANCE_RDS))))

df_CAMPER <- subset_taxa(Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED, CAMPER_id != "") |>
  subset_taxa(!is.na(CAMPER_module)) |>
  psmelt() |>
  dplyr::select(SPRUCE_ID, CAMPER_id, CAMPER_oxygen) |>
  group_by(SPRUCE_ID, CAMPER_oxygen) |>
  summarise(num_CAMPER_ids_detected = n_distinct(CAMPER_id), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = CAMPER_oxygen, values_from = num_CAMPER_ids_detected) |>
  replace_na(list(oxic = 0, anoxic = 0)) |>
  mutate(Specialist_phenol_decomposition = case_when(
    anoxic / (anoxic + oxic) >= 0.6 ~ "Anoxic_phenol_decomposition",
    oxic   / (anoxic + oxic) >= 0.6 ~ "Oxic_phenol_decomposition",
    TRUE                            ~ "Ambivalent_phenol_decomposition"))
write_out(df_CAMPER, p_meta("df_CAMPER.csv"))

tax_df$SPRUCE_ID_num <- as.numeric(gsub("SPRUCE (\\d+)", "\\1", tax_df$SPRUCE_ID))
cat("New MAGs (ID >= 2000):", sum(tax_df$SPRUCE_ID_num >= 2000, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAG set reconciliation
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The Results state that polyphenol degradation genes are nearly ubiquitous,
# ">99% encode oxygen-dependent or oxygen-independent enzymes". The numerator of
# that percentage is the number of genomes in df_CAMPER, which is derived from
# the gene object. The paper's denominator is the 294 dereplicated MAGs in the
# abundance and activity objects. The two are not the same set, so the block
# below reports every count and both percentages rather than assuming they agree.

mag_ids <- function(ps) {
  tt <- data.frame(tax_table(ps))
  if (!"SPRUCE_ID" %in% names(tt)) return(character(0))
  unique(na.omit(as.character(tt$SPRUCE_ID)))
}
mag_sets <- list(
  gene_object       = mag_ids(Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED),
  abundance_object  = unique(na.omit(as.character(tax_df$SPRUCE_ID))),
  activity_object   = mag_ids(readRDS(p_raw_req(MAG_ACTIVITY_RDS))),
  df_CAMPER         = unique(as.character(df_CAMPER$SPRUCE_ID)))

mag_set_sizes <- data.frame(object = names(mag_sets),
                            n_MAGs = vapply(mag_sets, length, integer(1)),
                            row.names = NULL)
print(mag_set_sizes, row.names = FALSE)

mag_pairs <- list(c("gene_object", "abundance_object"),
                  c("df_CAMPER",   "abundance_object"),
                  c("df_CAMPER",   "gene_object"),
                  c("activity_object", "abundance_object"))
mag_set_diffs <- purrr::map_dfr(mag_pairs, function(pr) {
  a <- mag_sets[[pr[1]]]; b <- mag_sets[[pr[2]]]
  data.frame(set_A = pr[1], set_B = pr[2],
             n_A = length(a), n_B = length(b),
             n_shared    = length(intersect(a, b)),
             n_only_in_A = length(setdiff(a, b)),
             n_only_in_B = length(setdiff(b, a)),
             only_in_A = paste(sort(setdiff(a, b)), collapse = "; "),
             only_in_B = paste(sort(setdiff(b, a)), collapse = "; "))
})
print(mag_set_diffs[, 1:7], row.names = FALSE)

# The percentage as it can be computed on each candidate denominator.
n_camper <- length(intersect(mag_sets$df_CAMPER, mag_sets$gene_object))
camper_pct <- data.frame(
  denominator = c("genomes in the gene object", "294 MAGs in the abundance object"),
  n_denominator = c(length(mag_sets$gene_object), length(mag_sets$abundance_object)),
  n_with_phenol_active_gene = c(
    n_camper,
    length(intersect(mag_sets$df_CAMPER, mag_sets$abundance_object))))
camper_pct$percent <- round(100 * camper_pct$n_with_phenol_active_gene /
                            camper_pct$n_denominator, 1)
print(camper_pct, row.names = FALSE)

if (length(setdiff(mag_sets$gene_object, mag_sets$abundance_object)))
  message("The gene object carries ", length(setdiff(mag_sets$gene_object,
          mag_sets$abundance_object)), " genome(s) absent from the 294-MAG set.")
```

## 2.6 ENZYME MODELS AND SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE S3

Gamma GLMM (log link) for phenol oxidase, Gaussian GLMM on log-transformed
hydrolase activity. Selection follows the porewater gas models in section 2.10:
the temperature by drawdown interaction is kept only where the LRT supports it,
and the random intercept is dropped when its variance is estimated at zero.

`CO2_Treatment` is fitted as a fixed effect here and is not in the dbRDA. The
dbRDA conditions on enclosure with `Condition(Plot)`, which removes all
among-enclosure variation, and CO2 is assigned per enclosure, so it is removed
along with it and cannot be estimated. These models put enclosure in as a random
intercept instead, which models the among-enclosure variation rather than
sweeping it out, so an enclosure-level fixed effect stays estimable.

```{r enzyme-models-and-fig}

enz_ABTS <- left_join(ABTS, metadata_df, by = c("Plot", "Year", "Depth")) |>
  filter(!is.na(Warming_Treatment)) |>
  group_by(Name) |>
  mutate(mean_ActivtypH = mean(ActivtypH, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

POX_LABEL <- "Phenol oxidase (Gamma, log link)"
pox_lrt <- lrt_interaction(
  mean_ActivtypH ~ Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm + CO2_Treatment +
    Temp_avg_top:WT_drawdown_cm + (1 | Plot),
  mean_ActivtypH ~ Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm + CO2_Treatment + (1 | Plot),
  enz_ABTS, family = Gamma(link = "log"), label = "Phenol oxidase")
pox_fixed <- drop_singular_re(pox_lrt$model, enz_ABTS, POX_LABEL)
pox <- list(model = pox_fixed$model, dropped_re = pox_fixed$dropped_re,
            lrt_p = pox_lrt$lrt_p)
register_model(tidy_glmmtmb(pox$model, POX_LABEL))
print(tidy_glmmtmb(pox$model, POX_LABEL))

fit_enz <- function(resp, label) {
  f <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste(resp, "~", rhs))
  r <- lrt_interaction(
    f("Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm + CO2_Treatment + Temp_avg_top:WT_drawdown_cm + (1|Plot)"),
    f("Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm + CO2_Treatment + (1|Plot)"),
    enz2, family = gaussian(), label = label)
  fixed <- drop_singular_re(r$model, enz2, label)
  register_model(tidy_glmmtmb(fixed$model, label))
  list(model = fixed$model, dropped_re = fixed$dropped_re, lrt_p = r$lrt_p)
}
res_BG   <- fit_enz("BG.h_log",   "beta-glucosidase (log)")
res_CB   <- fit_enz("CB.h_log",   "Cellobiohydrolase (log)")
res_NAG  <- fit_enz("NAG.h_log",  "beta-N-acetylglucosaminidase (log)")
res_PHOS <- fit_enz("PHOS.h_log", "Acid phosphatase (log)")

FIG_S3A <- ggplot(enz_ABTS, aes(x = WT_drawdown_cm, y = mean_ActivtypH)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Warming_Treatment.ord, shape = Year), colour = "black", size = 4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1, se = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(22, 24)) + scale_fill_manual(values = allGroupsColors) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend("Temperature\ntreatment", override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  xlab("Water table drawdown (cm)") +
  ylab(expression(Phenol ~ oxidase ~ activity ~ "(" * mu * "mol/kg*h)")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16))

enz2.long <- melt(enz2, id = c("WT_drawdown", "Warming_Treatment.ord", "Year"),
                  measure = c("BG.h", "CB.h", "NAG.h", "PHOS.h"))
colnames(enz2.long)[4] <- "Hydrolase"
levels(enz2.long$Hydrolase) <- c("beta-glucosidase", "cellobiohydrolase",
                                 "beta-N-acetylglucosaminidase", "acid phosphatase")

FIG_S3B <- ggplot(enz2.long, aes(x = WT_drawdown * 100, y = value, fill = Hydrolase)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Hydrolase), method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Hydrolase, shape = Year), size = 5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(22, 24)) +
  guides(shape = "none",
         fill  = guide_legend("Hydrolase", nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE,
                              override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
  scale_fill_npg() + scale_color_npg() +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log", labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  ylab(expression(Hydrolase ~ activity ~ "(" * mu * "mol/kg*h)")) +
  xlab("Water table drawdown (cm)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16))

save_fig(ggarrange(FIG_S3A, FIG_S3B, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"),
                   font.label = list(size = 18)),
         p_fig("Figure_S3_enzyme_activity.pdf"), width = 10, height = 5)
```

## 2.8 METABOLOMICS: NOSC

NOSC = -((-z + 4C + H - 3N - 2O + 5P - 2S) / C) + 4, with z = 0, from the KEGG
formula. Formulae that will not parse, or that contain no carbon, return NA and
are excluded. The sample-level value is the relative-abundance-weighted mean.

```{r load-metabolomics-nosc}

metabolites_phylo <- read_metab_ps()

if (!identical(taxa_names(metabolites_phylo),
               unname(as.character(tax_table(metabolites_phylo)[, "Feature"]))))
  stop("taxa_names() and the Feature column of the metabolite tax table are not ",
       "the same vector.")

calculate_nosc <- function(formula, z = 0) {
  if (is.na(formula) || formula == "") return(NA_real_)
  el <- str_match_all(formula, "([A-Z][a-z]*)(\\d*)")[[1]]
  if (nrow(el) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  n <- as.numeric(el[, 3]); n[is.na(n)] <- 1
  cnt <- setNames(n, el[, 2])
  g <- function(s) if (s %in% names(cnt)) cnt[[s]] else 0
  C <- g("C"); if (C == 0) return(NA_real_)
  -((-z + 4*C + g("H") - 3*g("N") - 2*g("O") + 5*g("P") - 2*g("S")) / C) + 4
}

metabolites_phylo_n <- transform_sample_counts(metabolites_phylo, function(x) x / sum(x))
tax_table_metab      <- as.data.frame(tax_table(metabolites_phylo_n))
tax_table_metab$NOSC <- vapply(tax_table_metab$KEGG_formula, calculate_nosc, numeric(1))
tax_table(metabolites_phylo_n) <- as.matrix(tax_table_metab)
tax_table(metabolites_phylo)   <- as.matrix(tax_table_metab)

cat("Features with a usable NOSC:", sum(!is.na(tax_table_metab$NOSC)),
    "of", nrow(tax_table_metab), "\n")

rel_mat <- as(otu_table(metabolites_phylo_n), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(metabolites_phylo_n)) rel_mat <- t(rel_mat)   # features x samples
nosc_vec <- tax_table_metab$NOSC[match(rownames(rel_mat), rownames(tax_table_metab))]
usable   <- !is.na(nosc_vec)
if (!any(usable))
  stop("No metabolite feature has a usable NOSC. Check that KEGG_formula is ",
       "populated and that tax_table rownames match the otu_table.")
sample_nosc <- colSums(rel_mat[usable, , drop = FALSE] * nosc_vec[usable])
cat(sprintf("NOSC: %d of %d features usable, covering %.1f%% of relative abundance\n",
            sum(usable), length(usable),
            100 * mean(colSums(rel_mat[usable, , drop = FALSE]))))

sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(metabolites_phylo_n))
sample_df <- sample_df[, !grepl("^NOSC", names(sample_df)), drop = FALSE]
sample_df$NOSC <- unname(sample_nosc[rownames(sample_df)])
if (all(is.na(sample_df$NOSC)))
  stop("NOSC did not map onto the samples. sample_data rownames are: ",
       paste(head(rownames(sample_df), 3), collapse = ", "),
       "; otu_table sample names are: ",
       paste(head(colnames(rel_mat), 3), collapse = ", "))
sample_data(metabolites_phylo_n) <- sample_df
sample_data(metabolites_phylo)   <- sample_df

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.8b  NOSC restricted to Level 1-3 annotations
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Levels 1-3: features with at least a computational structure proposal.
# Excluded: L4 (formula only, no name) and unannotated features.
HIGH_CONF       <- "^L1$|^L2$|^L3$"
HIGH_CONF_LABEL <- "Level 1-3"

conf_vec <- tax_table_metab$Annotation_Confidence[
  match(rownames(rel_mat), rownames(tax_table_metab))]
conf_lab <- ifelse(is.na(conf_vec) | conf_vec %in% c("", "NA"), "unannotated", conf_vec)

nosc_by_conf <- data.frame(
    Annotation_Confidence = conf_lab,
    has_formula           = usable,
    rel_abundance         = rowMeans(rel_mat)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Annotation_Confidence) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_features        = dplyr::n(),
                   n_with_NOSC       = sum(has_formula),
                   pct_with_NOSC     = round(100 * mean(has_formula), 1),
                   mean_rel_abund    = signif(sum(rel_abundance), 3),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_with_NOSC))
cat("\n=== NOSC coverage by annotation confidence ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(nosc_by_conf))

high <- usable & grepl(HIGH_CONF, conf_lab)
cat(sprintf("NOSC features at %s: %d of %d usable (%.1f%%)\n",
            HIGH_CONF_LABEL, sum(high), sum(usable), 100 * sum(high) / sum(usable)))

if (sum(high) >= 5) {
  sample_nosc_high <- colSums(rel_mat[high, , drop = FALSE] * nosc_vec[high])
  wt_high <- colSums(rel_mat[high, , drop = FALSE])
  sample_nosc_high_norm <- sample_nosc_high / wt_high

  sens <- data.frame(
    Sample          = names(sample_nosc),
    NOSC_all        = as.numeric(sample_nosc),
    NOSC_L1L3       = as.numeric(sample_nosc_high[names(sample_nosc)]),
    NOSC_L1L3_norm  = as.numeric(sample_nosc_high_norm[names(sample_nosc)]))
  r_raw  <- cor(sens$NOSC_all, sens$NOSC_L1L3,      use = "complete.obs")
  r_norm <- cor(sens$NOSC_all, sens$NOSC_L1L3_norm, use = "complete.obs")
  cat(sprintf("Sample NOSC, all formulae vs Level 1-3 only: r = %.3f (raw), %.3f (renormalised)\n",
              r_raw, r_norm))

  sens_dat <- sample_df
  sens_dat$NOSC_L1L3 <- sens$NOSC_L1L3_norm[match(rownames(sens_dat), sens$Sample)]
  sens_fit <- try(glmmTMB::glmmTMB(NOSC_L1L3 ~ Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm,
                                   data = sens_dat), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(sens_fit, "try-error")) {
    cat("\n--- NOSC (Level 1-3 only) ~ Temp + WT ---\n")
    print(tidy_glmmtmb(sens_fit, "Sample NOSC (Level 1-3 annotations only)"))
    register_model(tidy_glmmtmb(sens_fit, "Sample NOSC (Level 1-3 annotations only)"))
  }
} else {
  message("Fewer than 5 NOSC features at Level 1-3; sensitivity analysis skipped.")
}

write_out(sample_df, p_meta("metadata_with_NOSC.csv"))
saveRDS(metabolites_phylo, p_ps("PhyloseqObj_metabolites_withNOSC.RDS"))

nosc_data <- sample_df |> mutate(Plot = as.factor(Plot))
nosc <- lrt_interaction(
  NOSC ~ Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm + Temp_avg_top:WT_drawdown_cm + (1|Plot),
  NOSC ~ Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm + (1|Plot),
  nosc_data, label = "NOSC")
nosc_fix  <- drop_singular_re(nosc$model, nosc_data, "NOSC")
step_nosc <- nosc_fix$model
register_model(tidy_glmmtmb(step_nosc,
  paste0("Sample NOSC", if (nosc_fix$dropped_re) " (enclosure RE dropped, singular)" else "")))
print(tidy_glmmtmb(step_nosc, "Sample NOSC"))
```

## 2.9 MAASLIN2: METABOLITE RESPONSES

Primary model: both predictors in one Maaslin2 fit with the enclosure random
effect, `Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm + (1|Plot)`. Supplementary Data 3 and 4,
the FDR summary and the class-level tests come from this fit. The two
single-predictor fixed-effects fits are a sensitivity check.

```{r maaslin-metabolites}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.9.1  Feature table and annotations
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ps_met  <- read_metab_ps(quiet = TRUE)
keep    <- taxa_sums(ps_met) > 0
if (any(!keep)) ps_met <- prune_taxa(keep, ps_met)
cat("Metabolite features tested:", ntaxa(ps_met), "\n")

taxdf_met <- data.frame(tax_table(ps_met))
taxdf_met$feature <- rownames(taxdf_met)

# Mode, retention time and precursor m/z out of the feature ID; every compound
# name labelled with how many features carry it. The diastereomer alias and the
# "M" sentinel were handled in read_metab_ps(), so they are not repeated here.
taxdf_met <- cbind(taxdf_met, parse_feature_id(taxdf_met$feature))
taxdf_met <- add_name_multiplicity(taxdf_met)

print(as.data.frame(METAB_MSI_CENSUS), row.names = FALSE)

# --- Compound Discoverer per-feature values -----------------------------------
# Supplied as a keyed CSV in 00_inputs/ and left-joined at the point of use.
annot_path <- p_raw(METAB_ANNOT_UPDATE_FILE)
if (file.exists(annot_path)) {
  annot_upd <- readr::read_csv(annot_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  stopifnot("feature" %in% names(annot_upd))


  if ("Area_CV_percent_CD" %in% names(annot_upd)) {
    taxdf_met <- dplyr::left_join(
      taxdf_met, annot_upd[, c("feature", "Area_CV_percent_CD")], by = "feature")
    taxdf_met$Area_CV_percent    <- round(taxdf_met$Area_CV_percent_CD, 1)
    taxdf_met$Area_CV_percent_CD <- NULL
    cov_n <- sum(!is.na(taxdf_met$Area_CV_percent))
    cat(sprintf("Area CV%%: supplied for %d of %d features (%.1f%%)\n",
                cov_n, nrow(taxdf_met), 100 * cov_n / nrow(taxdf_met)))
    if (cov_n < nrow(taxdf_met))
      message("  Area CV% is partial. The published CV figure and by-level table ",
              "must state their denominator, or wait for the full CD export.")
  }
} else {
  message(METAB_ANNOT_UPDATE_FILE, " not in 00_inputs/. Supplementary Data 3 and 4 ",
          "will be written without Area_CV_percent.")
}

met_tax_cols <- c("feature", "Acquisition_mode", "RT_min", "precursor_mz",
                  "Final_name", "Name_n_features", "Name_status",
                  "Kingdom", "Superclass", "Class", "Subclass",
                  "Parent.Level.1", "Parent.Level.2", "Parent.Level.3",
                  "Parent.Level.4", "Parent.Level.5", "Annotation_Confidence")

  met_tax_cols <- c(met_tax_cols, "Area_CV_percent")

cat(sprintf("Acquisition modes present: %s\n",
            paste(sort(unique(na.omit(taxdf_met$Acquisition_mode))), collapse = ", ")))

# Census of compound names carried by more than one feature.
dup_names <- taxdf_met |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Name_n_features), Name_n_features > 1) |>
  dplyr::select(Final_name, feature, Acquisition_mode, RT_min, precursor_mz,
                Annotation_Confidence, Name_n_features) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Name_n_features), Final_name, RT_min)
# The Supplementary Methods quote this count. The denominator is every feature in
# the table, not the significant subset; the unnamed sentinel is already NA here.
cat(sprintf(paste0("Compound names carried by >1 feature: %d names, %d features ",
                   "(max %d per name), out of %d named features and %d features total\n"),
            dplyr::n_distinct(dup_names$Final_name), nrow(dup_names),
            if (nrow(dup_names)) max(dup_names$Name_n_features) else 0L,
            sum(!is.na(taxdf_met$Final_name)), nrow(taxdf_met)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.9.1b  Normalisation identity check
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

stored_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_met), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_met)) stored_mat <- t(stored_mat)
cat(sprintf("Stored intensities: %d features x %d samples, range %.4g to %.4g, %d zeros\n",
            nrow(stored_mat), ncol(stored_mat), min(stored_mat), max(stored_mat),
            sum(stored_mat == 0)))
cat("  No zeros and a", sprintf("%.1f", max(stored_mat) / min(stored_mat)),
    "fold total range: these are log2 values, not peak areas.\n")

raw_auc_path <- p_raw(RAW_AUC_FILE)
if (!file.exists(raw_auc_path))
  stop("A feature-wise coefficient of variation requires the raw peak areas. ",
       "The stored intensities are log2 values and a CV computed on them is ",
       "meaningless. Copy ", RAW_AUC_FILE, " into 00_inputs/ and re-knit, or ",
       "delete this block and the CV panel from the manuscript.")

# The first column of raw_auc_table.csv holds the feature IDs and has no header.
# Take it positionally.
raw_tbl <- readr::read_csv(raw_auc_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
raw_auc <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(raw_tbl)[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(raw_auc) <- as.character(raw_tbl[[1]])
storage.mode(raw_auc) <- "double"
cat(sprintf("  Raw AUC table: %d features x %d samples, range %.4g to %.4g, %d zeros\n",
            nrow(raw_auc), ncol(raw_auc), min(raw_auc), max(raw_auc),
            sum(raw_auc == 0)))

# Check that the stored intensities equal log2(2 * M * x / m_j).
shared_f <- intersect(rownames(raw_auc), rownames(stored_mat))
shared_s <- intersect(colnames(raw_auc), colnames(stored_mat))
if (length(shared_f) < 100 || length(shared_s) < 20)
  stop("Only ", length(shared_f), " feature(s) and ", length(shared_s),
       " sample(s) are shared between ", RAW_AUC_FILE, " and ", METAB_PS_FILE,
       ". Check the identifier conventions on both. Stored sample names are: ",
       paste(utils::head(colnames(stored_mat), 3), collapse = ", "),
       "; raw table sample names are: ",
       paste(utils::head(colnames(raw_auc), 3), collapse = ", "), ".")
m_j  <- colMeans(raw_auc)
M    <- mean(m_j)
recon <- log2(2 * M * sweep(raw_auc[shared_f, shared_s, drop = FALSE], 2,
                            m_j[shared_s], "/"))
norm_err <- max(abs(recon - stored_mat[shared_f, shared_s, drop = FALSE]))
cat(sprintf("  Mean-normalisation check on %d x %d shared cells: max |error| = %.3g\n",
            length(shared_f), length(shared_s), norm_err))
if (norm_err > 1e-6)
  warning("The stored intensities are not log2(2 * M * x / m_j) to within 1e-6. ",
          "The Methods description of the normalisation is wrong; max error ",
          signif(norm_err, 4), ".")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.9.2  Molecular weight from the KEGG formula
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ATOMIC_MASS <- c(C = 12.000, H = 1.00783, N = 14.00307, O = 15.99491,
                 P = 30.97376, S = 31.97207, Cl = 34.96885, Br = 78.91834,
                 F = 18.99840, I = 126.90447, Na = 22.98977, K = 38.96371)

calculate_mw <- function(formula) {
  if (is.na(formula) || formula == "") return(NA_real_)
  el <- stringr::str_match_all(formula, "([A-Z][a-z]*)(\\d*)")[[1]]
  if (nrow(el) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  n <- as.numeric(el[, 3]); n[is.na(n)] <- 1
  if (any(!el[, 2] %in% names(ATOMIC_MASS))) return(NA_real_)
  sum(ATOMIC_MASS[el[, 2]] * n)
}
taxdf_met$MW <- vapply(taxdf_met$KEGG_formula, calculate_mw, numeric(1))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.9.2b  Phenolic pool split by aromatic ring count
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

build_suppl_metab <- function(res, predictor_name, tag) {
  res$results |>
    dplyr::rename(feature = 1) |>
    dplyr::filter(metadata == predictor_name, pval < 0.05) |>
    add_effect_size() |>
    dplyr::mutate(metadata = tag) |>
    dplyr::left_join(taxdf_met[, c(met_tax_cols, "MW", "Ring_class")], by = "feature") |>
    dplyr::select(feature, Acquisition_mode, RT_min, precursor_mz,
                  metadata, coef, stderr, CI_lower, CI_upper, pval, qval,
                  evidence, N, dplyr::any_of(c("N.not.zero", "N.not.0")),
                  Final_name, Name_n_features, Name_status,
                  Kingdom, Superclass, Class, Subclass,
                  dplyr::starts_with("Parent.Level"), Annotation_Confidence,
                  dplyr::any_of("Area_CV_percent"), MW, Ring_class) |>
    dplyr::arrange(coef)
}

# Column definitions carried alongside Supplementary Data 3 and 4. Acquisition
# mode, retention time and precursor m/z are explicit columns rather than being
# encoded only in the feature ID, so repeated compound names can be assessed as
# isomers, adducts or duplicates.
SD34_HEADER_NOTE <- data.frame(column = c(
  "feature", "Acquisition_mode", "RT_min", "precursor_mz",
  "Final_name", "Name_n_features", "Name_status", "Annotation_Confidence",
  "Area_CV_percent"),
  definition = c(
    "Feature identifier, '<acquisition mode>_<retention time in min>_<precursor m/z>'.",
    "Chromatographic method and polarity the feature was detected in.",
    "Chromatographic retention time, minutes.",
    "Precursor m/z.",
    paste("Putative compound name. A name is an assignment, not an identification,",
          "unless Annotation_Confidence is L1. Stereoisomeric assignments that",
          "in-silico methods cannot separate are reported once, without a",
          "stereodescriptor."),
    "Number of features in the full table carrying this same compound name.",
    paste("Whether the name is unique to this feature, shared with others, or the",
          "feature is unnamed. Features sharing a name are not replicates; compare",
          "RT_min and precursor_mz to judge whether they are isomers or adducts."),
    paste("Metabolomics Standards Initiative level. L1, match to an authentic",
          "standard on precursor m/z (5 ppm), MS/MS spectrum and retention time",
          "(within 0.5 min), standards run on the same instrument, column and",
          "method as the samples. L2, full MS/MS match to mzCloud. L3, structure",
          "proposed computationally from predicted formula and compound class",
          "(SIRIUS, CSI:FingerID, CANOPUS, ClassyFire, ChemSpider). L4, molecular",
          "formula only, no putative name. L3 and L4 names are the best-matching",
          "candidate structure, not an identification."),
    paste("Compound Discoverer coefficient of variation of peak area for this",
          "compound across the sample set. This is dispersion across biological",
          "samples spanning a 0 to 9 degrees C warming gradient, three",
          "water-table regimes and three years, and is expected to be large for",
          "responsive features. It is not the pooled-QC relative standard",
          "deviation: the <30% QC RSD and <=25% correction-factor thresholds",
          "reported in the Supplementary Methods were applied to replicate",
          "injections of the pooled QC extract, which is a different quantity."))
)
# The definition list must match the columns actually written, or a reader will
# look for a column that is not there.
if (!"Area_CV_percent" %in% names(taxdf_met))
  SD34_HEADER_NOTE <- SD34_HEADER_NOTE[SD34_HEADER_NOTE$column != "Area_CV_percent", ]
write_out(SD34_HEADER_NOTE, p_sd("Suppl_Data_03_04_column_definitions.csv"))

Suppl_Data_03 <- build_suppl_metab(MaAslin_metab_multi, "WT_drawdown_cm", "WT_drawdown")
Suppl_Data_04 <- build_suppl_metab(MaAslin_metab_multi, "Temp_avg_top",   "Temp_avg_top")
write_out(Suppl_Data_03, p_sd("Suppl_Data_03_metabolites_WT.csv"))
write_out(Suppl_Data_04, p_sd("Suppl_Data_04_metabolites_temp.csv"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.9.5  Class-level competitive test
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class_level_competitive <- function(res, predictor_name, label, tax,
                                    level = "Superclass", min_n = 5) {
  df <- res$results |>
    dplyr::rename(feature = 1) |>
    dplyr::filter(metadata == predictor_name) |>
    dplyr::left_join(tax[, c("feature", level)], by = "feature") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[level]]), .data[[level]] != "")

  df |>
    dplyr::group_by(set = .data[[level]]) |>
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= min_n) |>
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      inset  <- .x
      outset <- dplyr::filter(df, .data[[level]] != .y$set[1])
      p_bg   <- mean(outset$coef > 0)
      data.frame(
        n_features  = nrow(inset),
        n_increase  = sum(inset$coef > 0),
        n_decrease  = sum(inset$coef < 0),
        median_coef = median(inset$coef),
        median_coef_background = median(outset$coef),
        p_KS     = suppressWarnings(ks.test(inset$pval, "punif")$p.value),
        p_wilcox = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(inset$coef, outset$coef)$p.value),
        p_sign   = if (p_bg > 0 && p_bg < 1)
                     binom.test(sum(inset$coef > 0), nrow(inset), p = p_bg)$p.value
                   else NA_real_)
    }) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(predictor = label, level = level,
                  q_KS     = p.adjust(p_KS,     method = "BH"),
                  q_wilcox = p.adjust(p_wilcox, method = "BH"),
                  q_sign   = p.adjust(p_sign,   method = "BH")) |>
    dplyr::arrange(p_wilcox)
}

class_comp <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(pred  = c("WT_drawdown_cm", "Temp_avg_top", "WT_drawdown_cm", "Temp_avg_top"),
       lab   = c("WT_drawdown", "Temp_avg_top", "WT_drawdown", "Temp_avg_top"),
       lev   = c("Superclass", "Superclass", "Class", "Class"),
       min_n = c(5, 5, 8, 8)),
  function(pred, lab, lev, min_n)
    class_level_competitive(MaAslin_metab_multi, pred, lab, taxdf_met, lev, min_n))
print(as.data.frame(class_comp), digits = 3)

# Single-ring versus multi-ring phenolics, each set the other's background.
class_comp_struct <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  class_level_competitive(MaAslin_metab_multi, "WT_drawdown_cm", "WT_drawdown",
                          taxdf_met, "Poly_struct_set"),
  class_level_competitive(MaAslin_metab_multi, "Temp_avg_top", "Temp_avg_top",
                          taxdf_met, "Poly_struct_set"))
print(as.data.frame(class_comp_struct), digits = 3)

# Free amino acids and peptides, each tested against everything else.
class_comp_AA <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  class_level_competitive(MaAslin_metab_multi, "WT_drawdown_cm", "WT_drawdown",
                          taxdf_met, "AA_set"),
  class_level_competitive(MaAslin_metab_multi, "Temp_avg_top", "Temp_avg_top",
                          taxdf_met, "AA_set")) |>
  dplyr::filter(set != "Rest of metabolome")
print(as.data.frame(class_comp_AA), digits = 3)

# Carbohydrates against the rest of the metabolome.
class_comp_carb <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  class_level_competitive(MaAslin_metab_multi, "WT_drawdown_cm", "WT_drawdown",
                          taxdf_met, "Carb_set"),
  class_level_competitive(MaAslin_metab_multi, "Temp_avg_top", "Temp_avg_top",
                          taxdf_met, "Carb_set")) |>
  dplyr::filter(set != "Rest of metabolome")
print(as.data.frame(class_comp_carb), digits = 3)

# Supplementary Data 5: ClassyFire superclass and class tests plus the
# phenolic ring-count split, in one sheet.
write_out(
  dplyr::bind_rows(class_comp, class_comp_struct, class_comp_AA, class_comp_carb) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      compound_set           = set,
      grouping               = dplyr::recode(level,
                                 Poly_struct_set = "Phenolic ring count",
                                 AA_set          = "Amino acid vs peptide",
                                 Carb_set        = "Carbohydrates",
                                 .default = level),
      predictor              = predictor,
      n_features             = n_features,
      n_increase             = n_increase,
      n_decrease             = n_decrease,
      median_coef            = median_coef,
      median_coef_background = median_coef_background,
      p_KS = p_KS, q_KS = q_KS,
      p_wilcox = p_wilcox, q_wilcox = q_wilcox,
      p_sign = p_sign, q_sign = q_sign) |>
    dplyr::arrange(grouping, predictor, q_wilcox),
  p_sd("Suppl_Data_05_classlevel_competitive.csv"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.9.6  Class-level test on class mean intensity, with the enclosure random effect
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

class_intensity <- {
  met_df   <- sample_matrix(ps_met)
  met_norm <- met_df / rowMeans(met_df, na.rm = TRUE)
  met_norm$SampleID <- rownames(met_norm)
  met_norm
} |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    data.frame(sample_data(ps_met)) |>
      dplyr::select(SampleID = Sample, Temp_avg_top, WT_drawdown_cm, Plot, Year),
    by = "SampleID") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(SampleID, Temp_avg_top, WT_drawdown_cm, Plot, Year),
                      names_to = "feature", values_to = "NormalizedIntensity") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(taxdf_met[, c("feature", "Superclass", "Class",
                                  "Poly_struct_set", "AA_set", "Carb_set")],
                    by = "feature")

fit_class_model <- function(dat, set_col) {
  dat |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[set_col]]), .data[[set_col]] != "") |>
    dplyr::group_by(SampleID, Temp_avg_top, WT_drawdown_cm, Plot, Year,
                    set = .data[[set_col]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(MeanIntensity = mean(NormalizedIntensity, na.rm = TRUE),
                     n_features = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(n_features >= 5) |>
    dplyr::group_by(set) |>
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      d <- .x
      # Predictors are standardised for conditioning and the slopes divided back
      # by the standard deviations, so coefficients stay on the per-unit scale.
      sd_t <- stats::sd(d$Temp_avg_top)
      sd_w <- stats::sd(d$WT_drawdown_cm)
      d$Temp_z <- as.numeric(scale(d$Temp_avg_top))
      d$WT_z   <- as.numeric(scale(d$WT_drawdown_cm))

      usable <- function(m) {
        if (inherits(m, "try-error") || is.null(m)) return(FALSE)
        cf <- try(summary(m)$coefficients$cond, silent = TRUE)
        !inherits(cf, "try-error") && all(c("Temp_z", "WT_z") %in% rownames(cf)) &&
          !any(is.nan(cf[, "Std. Error"])) && !any(is.na(cf[, "Std. Error"]))
      }

      m <- try(glmmTMB(MeanIntensity ~ Temp_z + WT_z + (1 | Plot), data = d),
               silent = TRUE)
      fit_type <- "mixed, scaled predictors"

      if (!usable(m)) {
        m <- try(glmmTMB(MeanIntensity ~ Temp_z + WT_z + (1 | Plot), data = d,
                         control = glmmTMBControl(optimizer = optim,
                                                  optArgs = list(method = "BFGS"))),
                 silent = TRUE)
        fit_type <- "mixed, scaled, BFGS"
      }
      if (!usable(m)) {
        m <- try(glmmTMB(MeanIntensity ~ Temp_z + WT_z, data = d), silent = TRUE)
        fit_type <- "fixed effects only (enclosure RE not estimable)"
      }
      if (!usable(m)) return(data.frame())

      cf  <- summary(m)$coefficients$cond
      r2m <- suppressWarnings(try(r.squaredGLMM(m)[1, "R2m"], silent = TRUE))
      data.frame(
        n_features      = d$n_features[1],
        coef_Temp       = cf["Temp_z", "Estimate"]   / sd_t,
        se_Temp         = cf["Temp_z", "Std. Error"] / sd_t,
        p_Temp          = cf["Temp_z", "Pr(>|z|)"],
        coef_WT         = cf["WT_z",   "Estimate"]   / sd_w,
        se_WT           = cf["WT_z",   "Std. Error"] / sd_w,
        p_WT            = cf["WT_z",   "Pr(>|z|)"],
        coef_Temp_perSD = cf["Temp_z", "Estimate"],
        coef_WT_perSD   = cf["WT_z",   "Estimate"],
        R2m             = if (inherits(r2m, "try-error")) NA_real_ else r2m,
        fit_type        = fit_type,
        converged       = TRUE)
    }) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(q_Temp = p.adjust(p_Temp, "BH"), q_WT = p.adjust(p_WT, "BH"))
}

class_selfcontained        <- fit_class_model(class_intensity, "Superclass")
class_selfcontained_struct <- fit_class_model(class_intensity, "Poly_struct_set")
class_selfcontained_AA     <- fit_class_model(class_intensity, "AA_set")
class_selfcontained_carb   <- fit_class_model(class_intensity, "Carb_set")
print(as.data.frame(class_selfcontained),        digits = 3)
print(as.data.frame(class_selfcontained_struct), digits = 3)

cat("\n=== Class-model fit types ===\n")
print(table(class_selfcontained$fit_type))
if (any(class_selfcontained$fit_type != "mixed, scaled predictors"))
  message("Classes not fitted with the mixed model: ",
          paste(class_selfcontained$set[
            class_selfcontained$fit_type != "mixed, scaled predictors"],
            collapse = ", "))
n_missing <- dplyr::n_distinct(class_intensity$Superclass[
  !is.na(class_intensity$Superclass) & class_intensity$Superclass != ""]) -
  nrow(class_selfcontained)
if (n_missing > 0)
  warning(n_missing, " class model(s) still failed to fit and are absent from the table.")

print(as.data.frame(class_selfcontained), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
# class_selfcontained_struct is the class-mean model on the single-ring versus
# multi-ring split. The manuscript reports the ring split only through the
# competitive tests in Supplementary Data 5, so this fit stays in the session and
# is not written out.
print(as.data.frame(class_selfcontained_AA), digits = 3)
print(as.data.frame(class_selfcontained_AA), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
print(as.data.frame(class_selfcontained_carb), digits = 3)
print(as.data.frame(class_selfcontained_carb), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.9.7  Sensitivity: single-predictor fixed-effects fits
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (REFIT_MAASLIN) {
```

```{r porewater-gas-models-and-fig}
      round(shapiro.test(na.omit(PWgas[[response]]))$p.value, 3), "\n")
```

## 3. dbRDA COMMUNITY ORDINATIONS — Figure 1, Supplementary Figures S4 and S9

Condition on enclosure for repeated sampling, and on depth for the amplicons.
Terms tested sequentially by permutation, 999 permutations, `by = "terms"`.
Each permutation test runs once and the result is reused for the figure
annotation and for Supplementary Data 7.

```{r dbrda-run}

DBRDA_PERM <- 999

run_dbrda <- function(dis, sampledf, condition = "Condition(Plot)",
                      label, expected_terms, seed = 1234) {
  cond <- paste(condition, collapse = " + ")
  f <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste("dis ~", rhs, "+", cond))

  full     <- vegan::dbrda(f("Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm"), data = sampledf)
  vif_full <- vif.cca(full)
  cat("\n=== ", label, ": VIF, full model ===\n"); print(vif_full)

  set.seed(seed)
  a_temp <- anova(vegan::dbrda(f("Temp_avg_top"),   data = sampledf), permutations = DBRDA_PERM)
  set.seed(seed)
  a_wt   <- anova(vegan::dbrda(f("WT_drawdown_cm"), data = sampledf), permutations = DBRDA_PERM)
  set.seed(seed)
  a_int  <- anova(vegan::dbrda(f("Temp_avg_top * WT_drawdown_cm"), data = sampledf),
                  by = "terms", permutations = DBRDA_PERM)

  int_row <- grep(":", rownames(a_int))
  p_int   <- if (length(int_row)) a_int$`Pr(>F)`[int_row[1]] else NA_real_
  cat(label, ": Temp alone P =", a_temp$`Pr(>F)`[1],
      "| WT alone P =", a_wt$`Pr(>F)`[1],
      "| interaction P =", p_int, "\n")

  chosen <- if (!is.na(p_int) && p_int < 0.05) {
    "Temp_avg_top * WT_drawdown_cm"
  } else {
    keep <- c("Temp_avg_top", "WT_drawdown_cm")[
      c(a_temp$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05, a_wt$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05)]
    if (length(keep) == 0) "Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm" else paste(keep, collapse = " + ")
  }
  if (!identical(chosen, expected_terms))
    message(label, ": selection gives '", chosen, "', expected '", expected_terms,
            "'. The selected model is the one fitted and plotted.")

  final <- vegan::dbrda(f(chosen), data = sampledf)
  set.seed(seed)
  a_final <- anova(final, permutations = DBRDA_PERM)
  r2 <- RsquareAdj(final)

  vif_sel <- vif.cca(final)
  cat("=== ", label, ": VIF, selected model (", chosen, ") ===\n", sep = "")
  print(vif_sel)
  pred_in <- intersect(names(vif_sel), c("Temp_avg_top", "WT_drawdown_cm"))
  if (any(vif_sel[pred_in] > 10, na.rm = TRUE))
    warning(label, ": VIF > 10 in the selected model for ",
            paste(pred_in[vif_sel[pred_in] > 10], collapse = ", "))

  list(label = label, model = final, terms = chosen, selected = chosen,
       submitted_terms = expected_terms,
       vif = vif_sel, vif_full = vif_full,
       anova = a_final, adj_R2 = r2$adj.r.squared,
       n = nrow(sampledf), p_temp = a_temp$`Pr(>F)`[1], p_wt = a_wt$`Pr(>F)`[1],
       p_interaction = p_int,
       stat = paste0("R2adj=", round(r2$adj.r.squared, 3),
                     ", F=", round(a_final$F[1], 2),
                     ", ", if (a_final$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.001) "p<0.001"
                           else paste0("p=", round(a_final$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)),
                     ", n=", nrow(sampledf)))
}

# axis2 is taken from the fitted model: a single-predictor model has one
# constrained axis, so the second axis is MDS1.
#
# ARROW_FRAC controls biplot arrow length. vegan returns biplot scores on the
# constrained-axis scale, which in some panels is much larger than the spread of
# the site scores, so an unscaled arrow runs off the plot. Every arrow in a panel
# is multiplied by one common factor chosen so the longest reaches ARROW_FRAC of
# that panel's site-score range. Relative arrow lengths and all angles are
# preserved within a panel; lengths are not comparable between panels, which is
# already true of biplot scores.
ARROW_FRAC <- 0.65

dbrda_panel <- function(fit, sampledf, fill_var, axis1 = "dbRDA1", axis2 = NULL,
                        arrow_labels, flip_x = FALSE, high, low,
                        title = NULL, arrow_frac = ARROW_FRAC) {
  site_axes <- colnames(scores(fit$model, display = "sites"))
  if (is.null(axis2))
    axis2 <- if (length(site_axes) > 1 && grepl("^dbRDA", site_axes[2])) site_axes[2] else "MDS1"
  smry <- summary(fit$model)
  prop <- smry$cont$importance["Proportion Explained", ]
  d1   <- cbind(data.frame(scores(fit$model, display = "sites")),
                Year = as.factor(sampledf$Year),
                Temp_avg_top = sampledf$Temp_avg_top,
                WT_drawdown_cm = sampledf$WT_drawdown_cm)
  ARROW_LABELS <- c(Temp_avg_top = "Temp", WT_drawdown_cm = "Water table\ndrawdown")
  d2 <- as.data.frame(scores(fit$model, display = "bp"))
  d2 <- d2[rownames(d2) %in% names(ARROW_LABELS), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!missing(arrow_labels) && length(arrow_labels) == nrow(d2)) {
    rownames(d2) <- arrow_labels
  } else {
    rownames(d2) <- unname(ARROW_LABELS[rownames(d2)])
  }

  # Rescale the arrows. Half-range on each axis, so an arrow drawn from the
  # origin at arrow_frac = 1 would just touch the edge of the site cloud.
  half_x <- max(abs(range(d1[[axis1]], na.rm = TRUE)))
  half_y <- max(abs(range(d1[[axis2]], na.rm = TRUE)))
  reach  <- max(sqrt((d2[[axis1]] / half_x)^2 + (d2[[axis2]] / half_y)^2), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.finite(reach) && reach > 0) {
    k <- arrow_frac / reach
    d2[[axis1]] <- d2[[axis1]] * k
    d2[[axis2]] <- d2[[axis2]] * k
  }

  s <- if (flip_x) -1 else 1

  ggplot(d1, aes(x = s * .data[[axis1]], y = .data[[axis2]])) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = .data[[fill_var]], shape = Year), color = "black", size = 6) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(high = high, low = low) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_segment(data = d2, aes(x = 0, xend = s * .data[[axis1]], y = 0, yend = .data[[axis2]]),
                 color = "grey20", arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.01, "npc")), linewidth = 2) +
    geom_text(data = d2, aes(x = s * .data[[axis1]], y = .data[[axis2]],
                             label = rownames(d2),
                             hjust = 0.5 * (1 - sign(s * .data[[axis1]])),
                             vjust = 0.5 * (1 - sign(.data[[axis2]]))),
              color = "grey20", size = 4.5, lineheight = 0.9) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = fit$stat,
             hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.5, color = "grey40", size = 4) +
    # Extra x expansion so the "Water table drawdown" label, which is drawn
    # outward from the arrow tip, is not clipped at the panel edge.
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.14)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.10)) +
    labs(title = title) +
    xlab(paste0(axis1, " (", round(prop[axis1] * 100, 1), "%)")) +
    ylab(paste0(axis2, " (", round(prop[axis2] * 100, 1), "%)")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5,
                                    margin = margin(b = 10)),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 12, r = 8, b = 6, l = 8))
}

# --- Datasets ------------------------------------------------------------------

peat16S.phy.RA <- readRDS(p_raw_req("peat16S_phy.rds")) |>
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) |>
  subset_samples(!is.na(Warming))
peatITS.phy.RA <- readRDS(p_raw_req("peatITS.phy.rds")) |>
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) |>
  subset_samples(!is.na(Warming))
metabolites.phy.RA <- transform_sample_counts(metabolites_phylo, function(x) x / sum(x))
droughtMAG.ps          <- readRDS(p_raw_req(MAG_ABUNDANCE_RDS))
droughtMAG.activity.ps <- readRDS(p_raw_req(MAG_ACTIVITY_RDS))

# Derive WT_drawdown_cm where it is missing and join the remaining model
# predictors from the canonical metadata on Year + Plot.
repair_mag_metadata <- function(ps, label) {
  sd_now  <- data.frame(sample_data(ps), check.names = FALSE)
  keep_rn <- rownames(sd_now)
  needed  <- c("WT_drawdown_cm", "AvgTemp10cm", "Temp_avg_top", "NOSC")
  before  <- setdiff(needed, names(sd_now))

  if (!"WT_drawdown_cm" %in% names(sd_now) && "WT_drawdown" %in% names(sd_now))
    sd_now$WT_drawdown_cm <- sd_now$WT_drawdown * 100

  still <- setdiff(needed, names(sd_now))
  if (length(still)) {
    if (!all(c("Year", "Plot") %in% names(sd_now)))
      stop(label, ": cannot join metadata, sample_data has no Year/Plot. Present: ",
           paste(sort(names(sd_now)), collapse = ", "))
    src <- sample_df |>
      dplyr::mutate(.y = as.character(Year), .p = as.character(Plot)) |>
      dplyr::select(.y, .p, dplyr::any_of(still)) |>
      dplyr::distinct(.y, .p, .keep_all = TRUE)
    sd_now$.y <- as.character(sd_now$Year)
    sd_now$.p <- as.character(sd_now$Plot)
    n_before  <- nrow(sd_now)
    sd_now    <- dplyr::left_join(sd_now, src, by = c(".y", ".p"))
    if (nrow(sd_now) != n_before)
      stop(label, ": metadata join duplicated rows (", n_before, " -> ", nrow(sd_now), ")")
    sd_now$.y <- NULL; sd_now$.p <- NULL
    rownames(sd_now) <- keep_rn
  }

  after <- setdiff(needed, names(sd_now))
  cat(sprintf("  %-10s missing before: %-32s after: %s\n", label,
              if (length(before)) paste(before, collapse = ", ") else "none",
              if (length(after))  paste(after,  collapse = ", ") else "none"))
  for (v in intersect(needed, names(sd_now))) {
    n_na <- sum(is.na(sd_now[[v]]))
    if (n_na) cat(sprintf("             %s has %d/%d NA\n", v, n_na, nrow(sd_now)))
  }

  sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(sd_now)
  ps
}

cat("\n=== MAG metadata repair ===\n")

                     "Metabolites",    "WT_drawdown_cm")
fit_abd <- run_dbrda(dis_abd, sd_abd, "Condition(Plot)",
                     "MAG abundance",  "Temp_avg_top + WT_drawdown_cm")
fit_act <- run_dbrda(dis_act, sd_act, "Condition(Plot)",
                     "MAG activity",   "Temp_avg_top * WT_drawdown_cm")

DBRDA_FITS <- list(fit_act, fit_met, fit_16S, fit_ITS, fit_abd)
```

```{r dbrda-figures, fig.width=12, fig.height=13.5}
# Panel C carries a two-line title; pad the one-line titles so the four plot
# areas in Figure 1 still start at the same height.
PANEL_TITLE_LINES <- 2
pad_title <- function(p, n = PANEL_TITLE_LINES) {
  t <- p$labels$title
  if (is.null(t) || !nzchar(t)) return(p)
  extra <- n - lengths(regmatches(t, gregexpr("\n", t, fixed = TRUE)))[1] - 1
  if (extra > 0) p <- p + labs(title = paste0(t, strrep("\n", extra)))
  p
}
```

```{r dbrda-varpart, fig.width=16, fig.height=4}

varpart_one <- function(dis, sampledf, label) {
  vp <- varpart(dis, sampledf[, "Temp_avg_top", drop = FALSE],
                     sampledf[, "WT_drawdown_cm", drop = FALSE])
  cat("\n=== VarPart:", label, "===\n"); print(vp)
  vp
}
vp_MAGactivity <- varpart_one(dis_act, sd_act, "MAG activity")
vp_metabolites <- varpart_one(dis_met, sd_met, "Metabolites")
vp_16S         <- varpart_one(dis_16S, sd_16S, "16S amplicons")

# Partial permutation tests. Each predictor is tested with the other one moved
# into the conditioning term, so the test matches the unique fraction reported by
# varpart. The marginal tests in run_dbrda() test each predictor on its own and
# do not.
partial_dbrda <- function(dis, sampledf, condition, label, seed = 1234) {
  cond <- paste(c(condition), collapse = " + ")
  one <- function(pred, other) {
    f <- as.formula(paste("dis ~", pred, "+ Condition(", other, ") +", cond))
    set.seed(seed)
    a <- anova(vegan::dbrda(f, data = sampledf), permutations = DBRDA_PERM)
    r <- RsquareAdj(vegan::dbrda(f, data = sampledf))$adj.r.squared
    data.frame(model = label, predictor = pred,
               conditioned_on = paste(other, cond, sep = " + "),
               partial_adj_R2 = r, F_stat = a$F[1], p_partial = a$`Pr(>F)`[1],
               n = nrow(sampledf), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(one("Temp_avg_top",   "WT_drawdown_cm"),
                   one("WT_drawdown_cm", "Temp_avg_top"))
}

PARTIAL_TESTS <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  partial_dbrda(dis_act, sd_act, "Condition(Plot)",                          "MAG activity"),
  partial_dbrda(dis_met, sd_met, "Condition(Plot)",                          "Metabolites"),
  partial_dbrda(dis_16S, sd_16S, c("Condition(Depth)", "Condition(Plot)"),   "16S amplicons"),
  partial_dbrda(dis_ITS, sd_ITS, c("Condition(Depth)", "Condition(Plot)"),   "ITS amplicons"),
  partial_dbrda(dis_abd, sd_abd, "Condition(Plot)",                          "MAG abundance"))

cat("\n=== Partial dbRDA tests (each predictor conditioned on the other) ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(PARTIAL_TESTS), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
# Not written on its own. These values are published beside the marginal tests in
# Table_dbRDA_marginal_vs_partial.csv, which is the table the Results quote.

# Marginal and partial P values side by side.
print(
  purrr::map_dfr(DBRDA_FITS, \(f) data.frame(
      model = f$label, predictor = c("Temp_avg_top", "WT_drawdown_cm"),
      p_marginal = c(f$p_temp, f$p_wt))) |>
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(PARTIAL_TESTS, model, predictor,
                                   partial_adj_R2, p_partial),
                     by = c("model", "predictor")), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)

pdf(p_fig("Figure_S9_variation_partitioning.pdf"), width = 16, height = 4)
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(vp_MAGactivity, digits = 2, Xnames = c("Temp","Water\ntable"),
     main = "MAG Activity",  bg = c("tomato","steelblue"))
plot(vp_metabolites, digits = 2, Xnames = c("Temp","Water\ntable"),
     main = "Metabolites",   bg = c("tomato","steelblue"))
plot(vp_16S,         digits = 2, Xnames = c("Temp","Water\ntable"),
     main = "16S Amplicons", bg = c("tomato","steelblue"))
dev.off()
FILE_LOG <- c(FILE_LOG, p_fig("Figure_S9_variation_partitioning.pdf"))

# Fractions are derived from vp$part$fract, whose row names state the model each
# one came from: X1 is temperature, X2 is water table.
#
#   unique_temp = R2(X1+X2) - R2(X2 alone)
#   unique_WT   = R2(X1+X2) - R2(X1 alone)
#   shared      = R2(X1 alone) + R2(X2 alone) - R2(X1+X2)
#   unexplained = 1 - R2(X1+X2)

varpart_fractions <- function(vp, nm) {
  fr  <- vp$part$fract
  col <- grep("^Adj", colnames(fr), value = TRUE)[1]
  rn  <- rownames(fr)
  has1 <- grepl("X1", rn); has2 <- grepl("X2", rn)
  i_ab  <- which(has1 & !has2)   # temperature alone
  i_bc  <- which(has2 & !has1)   # water table alone
  i_abc <- which(has1 &  has2)   # both
  stopifnot(length(i_ab) == 1, length(i_bc) == 1, length(i_abc) == 1)

  ab  <- fr[i_ab,  col]
  bc  <- fr[i_bc,  col]
  abc <- fr[i_abc, col]

  out <- data.frame(model = nm,
                    temp_alone   = ab,
                    WT_alone     = bc,
                    both         = abc,
                    unique_temp  = abc - bc,
                    unique_WT    = abc - ab,
                    shared       = ab + bc - abc,
                    unexplained  = 1 - abc,
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(out$unique_temp + out$unique_WT + out$shared, abc,
                             tolerance = 1e-8)))
  out
}

VP_LIST <- list("MAG Activity" = vp_MAGactivity, "Metabolites" = vp_metabolites,
                "16S Amplicons" = vp_16S)

cat("\n=== varpart fract tables, as labelled by vegan ===\n")
for (nm in names(VP_LIST)) {
  cat("\n--", nm, "--\n"); print(VP_LIST[[nm]]$part$fract)
  cat("   indfract rows, in file order:\n"); print(VP_LIST[[nm]]$part$indfract)
}

VARPART <- purrr::imap_dfr(VP_LIST, varpart_fractions)

# The partial test P value belongs with the unique fraction it corresponds to.
pt <- PARTIAL_TESTS |>
  dplyr::mutate(.m = tolower(model)) |>
  dplyr::select(.m, predictor, p_partial) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = predictor, values_from = p_partial,
                     names_prefix = "p_unique_")
VARPART <- VARPART |>
  dplyr::mutate(.m = tolower(model)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(pt, by = ".m") |>
  dplyr::select(-.m) |>
  dplyr::rename(p_unique_temp = p_unique_Temp_avg_top,
                p_unique_WT   = p_unique_WT_drawdown_cm) |>
  dplyr::relocate(p_unique_temp, .after = unique_temp) |>
  dplyr::relocate(p_unique_WT,   .after = unique_WT)
if (any(is.na(VARPART$p_unique_temp) | is.na(VARPART$p_unique_WT)))
  stop("Partial test P values did not join onto every varpart row. ",
       "Check that VP_LIST names match PARTIAL_TESTS$model.")

cat("\n=== Variation partitioning ===\n"); print(VARPART, row.names = FALSE)

# The raw vegan fractions behind the summary above and Supplementary Figure S9.
print(purrr::imap_dfr(VP_LIST, \(vp, nm) {
    ind <- vp$part$indfract
    col <- grep("^Adj", colnames(ind), value = TRUE)[1]
    data.frame(model = nm, fraction = rownames(ind),
               adj_R2 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ind[[col]])),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)}), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r fig2, fig.width=15, fig.height=15}
PWgas_sub <- PWgas |>
  group_by(Year, Plot) |>
  dplyr::summarise(across(c(CH4mM, CO2mM), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>

# Figure 2B is relative abundance. The axis label is built from the same

FIG2B_MEASURE <- "abundance"
fig2b_ps      <- droughtMAG.ps
FIG2B_AXIS    <- paste("Total relative", FIG2B_MEASURE, "of")

summarise_genome_group <- function(ids, ps = fig2b_ps, label = "genome group") {
  keep <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps) %in% ids, ps)
  if (!setequal(taxa_names(keep), ids))
    stop(label, ": genomes missing from the object: ",
         paste(setdiff(ids, taxa_names(keep)), collapse = ", "))
  out <- psmelt(keep) |>
    dplyr::select(Abundance, SPRUCE_ID, Warming, Year, CO2_Treatment, AvgTemp10cm,
                  Temp_avg_top, WT_drawdown, Warming_Treatment.ord, Plot) |>
    mutate(WT_drawdown_cm = WT_drawdown * 100, Year = as.factor(Year), Plot = as.factor(Plot)) |>
    left_join(PWgas_sub, by = c("Year", "Plot")) |>
    filter(!is.na(CO2mM)) |>
    group_by(Warming, Year, CO2_Treatment, AvgTemp10cm, Temp_avg_top,
             WT_drawdown_cm, Warming_Treatment.ord, Plot, CO2mM) |>
    dplyr::summarize(sum_Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
                     n_genomes = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  if (!all(out$n_genomes == length(ids)))
    stop(label, ": incomplete genome sums, n_genomes ranges ",
         paste(range(out$n_genomes), collapse = "-"), " but should be ", length(ids))
  out
}
```
