## 5. CO-OCCURRENCE NETWORK (SpiecEasi) — Figure 3

`RUN_NETWORK <- TRUE` fits SpiecEasi and writes `se_FULL.RDS` and
`assoMat_FULL.Rds` into `08_network/`. `FALSE` reloads those two files and
rebuilds the graph, the linking tables and the figure from them.

Everything this section writes goes to `08_network/`, except Supplementary
Data 10, which also goes to `04_suppl_data/`.

```{r network-build}

# Refit SpiecEasi RESAMPLE_N times on random 80% subsets of the metabolite
# features and record, for each edge of the displayed network, the fraction of
# replicates in which it is recovered. This tests sensitivity to the retained
# metabolite set; it is not a bootstrap over samples.
resample_edge_recovery <- function(target_edges, mag_mat, met_mat, n_rep) {
  recovered <- replicate(n_rep, {
    keep_cols <- sample(seq_len(ncol(met_mat)), round(0.8 * ncol(met_mat)))
    se_r <- multi.spiec.easi(list(mag_mat, met_mat[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]),
      method = "mb", lambda.min.ratio = 1e-3, nlambda = 20,
      pulsar.params = list(rep.num = 20, ncores = 1))
    m <- as.matrix(symBeta(getOptBeta(se_r), mode = "ave"))
    dimnames(m) <- list(c(colnames(mag_mat), colnames(met_mat)[keep_cols]),
                        c(colnames(mag_mat), colnames(met_mat)[keep_cols]))
    gg <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(m, mode = "undirected",
                                      weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
    e  <- apply(ends(gg, E(gg)), 1, \(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = "|"))
    target_edges %in% e
  })
  data.frame(edge = target_edges, recovery_frequency = rowMeans(recovered))
}

PS_helper     <- function(x) (x - mean(x)) / sqrt(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
pareto_scale  <- function(x) data.frame(apply(x, 2, PS_helper))
log_helper    <- function(x, min.val) log2((x + sqrt(x^2 + min.val^2)) / 2)
log_transform <- function(x) {
  x_nz    <- x[, which(apply(x, 2, sum) != 0)]
  min.val <- min(abs(x_nz[x_nz != 0])) / 10
  data.frame(apply(x_nz, 2, log_helper, min.val))
}
get_sample_matrix <- function(ps) {
  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
  otu
}

# ---- Metabolites -------------------------------------------------------------

# Same reader as sections 2.8 and 2.9, so the network is built on exactly the
# metabolite set the supplementary tables describe: unnamed sentinel filtered,
# MSI levels on the four-level scheme.
metab_net_ps <- read_metab_ps(quiet = TRUE)
met_clean <- data.frame(otu_table(metab_net_ps, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)) |>
  log_transform() |> pareto_scale()
metabolites_clean <- metab_net_ps
metabolites_clean@otu_table <- otu_table(as.matrix(met_clean), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

# Above the 30th percentile of taxa_sums, then restricted to features with an
# annotation confidence and a name.
threshold <- quantile(taxa_sums(metabolites_clean), ABUND_QUANTILE)
metabolites_phylo_sub <- metabolites_clean |>
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(metabolites_clean) > threshold, x = _) |>
  subset_taxa(!is.na(Annotation_Confidence)) |>
  subset_taxa(!is.na(Final_name))
cat(sprintf("  Metabolites: %d (from %d)\n",
            ntaxa(metabolites_phylo_sub), ntaxa(metab_net_ps)))
# The "M" sentinel is removed upstream in read_metab_ps(), so !is.na(Final_name)
# already excludes it. Assert rather than filter again, so a regression shows up
# here instead of silently changing the network input.
stopifnot(!any(as.data.frame(tax_table(metabolites_phylo_sub))$Final_name %in% "M"))
saveRDS(metabolites_phylo_sub, p_net("metabolites_phylo_Filtered.RDS"))

# ---- MAGs --------------------------------------------------------------------

MAGactivity.net.ps <- readRDS(p_raw_req(MAG_ACTIVITY_RDS))
sampledf_net <- data.frame(sample_data(MAGactivity.net.ps))
sample_names(MAGactivity.net.ps) <- paste0("P", sampledf_net$Plot, "_", sampledf_net$Year)

# Methanogens by KEGG module presence.
methanogen_modules <- c("Methanogen_CO2_M00567", "Methanogen_Acetate_M00357",
                        "Methanogen_Methanol_M00356", "Methanogen_Methylamine_M00563")
mods    <- read_csv(p_raw_req(MODULE_CSV), show_col_types = FALSE)
present <- intersect(methanogen_modules, names(mods))
methanogens <- mods$SPRUCE_ID[rowSums(!is.na(mods[, present, drop = FALSE]) &
                                      mods[, present, drop = FALSE] != "") > 0]
stopifnot(setequal(methanogens, METHANOGEN_IDS))

targets <- Clustered_df$SPRUCE_ID[Clustered_df$Cluster %in%
  c("Warming-stimulated anoxic", "Warming-stimulated oxic", "Warming-inhibited")]
ps_MAG_sub <- subset_taxa(MAGactivity.net.ps, SPRUCE_ID %in% c(targets, methanogens))
cat(sprintf("  MAGs: %d (%d warming-responsive + %d methanogens)\n",
            ntaxa(ps_MAG_sub), length(targets), length(methanogens)))
saveRDS(ps_MAG_sub, p_net("ps_MAG_FilteredSensitive.RDS"))

# ---- Align -------------------------------------------------------------------

mag_mat <- get_sample_matrix(ps_MAG_sub)
met_mat <- get_sample_matrix(metabolites_phylo_sub)
shared  <- sort(intersect(rownames(mag_mat), rownames(met_mat)))
mag_mat <- mag_mat[shared, , drop = FALSE]
met_mat <- met_mat[shared, , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(mag_mat), rownames(met_mat)))
cat(sprintf("  Samples: %d | MAGs: %d | Metabolites: %d\n",
            nrow(mag_mat), ncol(mag_mat), ncol(met_mat)))

# ---- SpiecEasi ---------------------------------------------------------------

if (RUN_NETWORK) {
  se_FULL <- multi.spiec.easi(list(mag_mat, met_mat), method = "mb",
    lambda.min.ratio = 1e-3, nlambda = 20,
    pulsar.params = list(rep.num = 20, ncores = 1))
  assoMat_FULL <- as.matrix(symBeta(getOptBeta(se_FULL), mode = "ave"))
  dimnames(assoMat_FULL) <- list(c(colnames(mag_mat), colnames(met_mat)),
                                 c(colnames(mag_mat), colnames(met_mat)))
  diag(assoMat_FULL) <- 1
  saveRDS(se_FULL,      p_net("se_FULL.RDS"))
  saveRDS(assoMat_FULL, p_net("assoMat_FULL.Rds"))
} else {
  se_FULL      <- readRDS(net_path("se_FULL.RDS"))
  assoMat_FULL <- readRDS(net_path("assoMat_FULL.Rds"))
}

# StARS stability is a whole-network quantity, not a per-edge quantity.
cat(sprintf("  StARS stability: %.4f | edges: %d\n",
            getStability(se_FULL), sum(getRefit(se_FULL)) / 2))
```

```{r network-graph, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}

all_MAGs <- c(targets, methanogens)
g_full <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(assoMat_FULL, mode = "undirected",
                                      weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
g_full <- set_edge_attr(g_full, "color",
  value = ifelse(edge_attr(g_full, "weight") > 0, "forestgreen", "#D2042D"))

ee   <- ends(g_full, E(g_full))
keep_e <- which(degree(g_full, ee[,1]) > DEGREE_THRESHOLD |
                degree(g_full, ee[,2]) > DEGREE_THRESHOLD)
g_sub <- subgraph_from_edges(g_full, keep_e)
ee2   <- ends(g_sub, E(g_sub))
g_sub2 <- induced_subgraph(g_sub,
  unique(c(ee2[which(ee2[,1] %in% all_MAGs | ee2[,2] %in% all_MAGs), ])))
cat(sprintf("  After degree filter (>%d): %d edges\n", DEGREE_THRESHOLD, ecount(g_sub)))

G1 <- Clustered_df$SPRUCE_ID[Clustered_df$Cluster == "Warming-stimulated anoxic"]
G2 <- Clustered_df$SPRUCE_ID[Clustered_df$Cluster == "Warming-stimulated oxic"]
G3 <- Clustered_df$SPRUCE_ID[Clustered_df$Cluster == "Warming-inhibited"]

get_edge_weight <- function(a, b, m)
  if (a %in% rownames(m) && b %in% colnames(m)) m[a, b] else NA_real_

connections_df <- purrr::map_dfr(V(g_sub2)$name[V(g_sub2)$name %in% targets], function(smag) {
  metabs <- setdiff(neighbors(g_sub2, smag)$name, all_MAGs)
  purrr::map_dfr(metabs, function(metab) {
    meths <- intersect(neighbors(g_sub2, metab)$name, methanogens)
    if (!length(meths)) return(NULL)
    w1 <- get_edge_weight(smag, metab, assoMat_FULL)
    purrr::map_dfr(meths, function(meth) {
      w2 <- get_edge_weight(metab, meth, assoMat_FULL)
      data.frame(genome = smag, metabolite = metab, methanogen = meth,
                 weight_genome_metab = w1, weight_metab_methanogen = w2,
                 sign_genome_metab     = ifelse(is.na(w1), NA, ifelse(w1 > 0, "positive", "negative")),
                 sign_metab_methanogen = ifelse(is.na(w2), NA, ifelse(w2 > 0, "positive", "negative")))
    })
  })
})
if (nrow(connections_df) == 0) stop("No genome-metabolite-methanogen paths found.")
cat(sprintf("  Genome-methanogen connections: %d\n", nrow(connections_df)))

df_metab <- tibble::rownames_to_column(data.frame(tax_table(metabolites_phylo_sub)), "metabolite")
df_metab$Final_name <- apply_name_aliases(df_metab$Final_name)
df_MAG   <- data.frame(tax_table(ps_MAG_sub))

write_out(connections_df, p_net("Linking_Metabolites.csv"))
write_out(left_join(connections_df, df_metab, by = "metabolite"),
          p_net("Linking_Metabolites_INFO.csv"))

path_verts <- unique(c(connections_df$genome, connections_df$metabolite, connections_df$methanogen))
g_net <- induced_subgraph(g_sub2, path_verts)
drop_same_type <- function(g, type) {
  ee <- ends(g, E(g))
  t1 <- ifelse(ee[,1] %in% all_MAGs, "MAG", "Metabolite")
  t2 <- ifelse(ee[,2] %in% all_MAGs, "MAG", "Metabolite")
  delete_edges(g, which(t1 == type & t2 == type))
}
g_net <- drop_same_type(drop_same_type(g_net, "Metabolite"), "MAG")
cat(sprintf("  Final: %d nodes | %d edges\n", vcount(g_net), ecount(g_net)))
saveRDS(g_net, p_net("igraph_Fig3_network.RDS"))

# ---- Edge recovery under node resampling -------------------------------------
# The stored result in 00_inputs/ is valid only for the edge set it was computed
# on. If the metabolite filter, the abundance quantile or the SpiecEasi fit
# changes the displayed edges, the knit either recomputes (RUN_RESAMPLE) or stops.

fig3_edges  <- apply(ends(g_net, E(g_net)), 1, \(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = "|"))
stab_path   <- p_raw("Check_Fig3_edge_stability.csv")
stab_stored <- if (file.exists(stab_path))
  read_csv(stab_path, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
stab_stale  <- is.null(stab_stored) || !setequal(stab_stored$edge, fig3_edges)

if (stab_stale && !RUN_RESAMPLE)
  stop("Check_Fig3_edge_stability.csv does not describe the current Figure 3 edge set. ",
       if (is.null(stab_stored)) "The file is missing. " else paste0(
         length(setdiff(stab_stored$edge, fig3_edges)), " edge(s) only in the file, ",
         length(setdiff(fig3_edges, stab_stored$edge)), " only in the graph. "),
       "Set RUN_RESAMPLE <- TRUE and re-knit; budget roughly ", RESAMPLE_N,
       " x the SpiecEasi fit time.")

if (stab_stale) {
  message("Edge set changed. Refitting SpiecEasi ", RESAMPLE_N,
          " times on random 80% subsets of the metabolite set.")
  edge_stability <- resample_edge_recovery(fig3_edges, mag_mat, met_mat, RESAMPLE_N)
  write.csv(edge_stability, stab_path, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  edge_stability <- stab_stored
}

metab_name_all <- setNames(df_metab$Final_name, df_metab$metabolite)
edge_stability <- edge_stability |>
  tidyr::separate(edge, c("node_a", "node_b"), sep = "\\|", remove = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    MAG             = ifelse(node_a %in% all_MAGs, node_a, node_b),
    metabolite      = ifelse(node_a %in% all_MAGs, node_b, node_a),
    metabolite_name = unname(metab_name_all[metabolite]),
    edge_type       = ifelse(MAG %in% methanogens,
                             "metabolite-methanogen", "MAG-metabolite")) |>
  dplyr::select(edge, MAG, metabolite, metabolite_name, edge_type, recovery_frequency) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(recovery_frequency))

rf <- edge_stability$recovery_frequency
cat(sprintf(
  "\nFigure 3 edge recovery, %d resampling replicates: %d edges, median %.2f, mean %.2f, range %.2f to %.2f\n",
  RESAMPLE_N, length(rf), median(rf), mean(rf), min(rf), max(rf)))
for (thr in c(0.5, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9))
  cat(sprintf("  recovered in >= %.0f%% of replicates: %d of %d\n",
              100 * thr, sum(rf >= thr), length(rf)))

# ---- Node metadata and plot --------------------------------------------------

vn <- V(g_net)$name
metab_superclass <- setNames(df_metab$Superclass, df_metab$metabolite)

classify_metab <- function(superclass) dplyr::case_when(
  superclass == "Lipids and lipid-like molecules"      ~ "Lipids and derivatives",
  superclass %in% c("Organic acids and derivatives", "Organic nitrogen compounds",
                    "Organoheterocyclic compounds", "Nucleosides, nucleotides, and analogues",
                    "Alkaloids and derivatives")       ~ "Amino acids and derivatives",
  superclass %in% NETWORK_PHENOLIC_SUPERCLASSES        ~ "Phenolic and polyphenolic compounds",
  TRUE                                                 ~ "Other organic compounds")

node_group <- dplyr::case_when(
  vn %in% methanogens ~ "Methanogen",
  vn %in% G1 ~ "Warming-stimulated anoxic-preferring",
  vn %in% G2 ~ "Warming-stimulated oxic-preferring",
  vn %in% G3 ~ "Warming-inhibited",
  TRUE ~ classify_metab(metab_superclass[vn]))
node_type  <- ifelse(vn %in% all_MAGs, "MAG", "Metabolite")

mag_lookup   <- setNames(paste0(df_MAG$SPRUCE_ID, ": ", df_MAG$Phylum), df_MAG$SPRUCE_ID)
metab_lookup <- setNames(df_metab$Final_name, df_metab$metabolite)

# Two independent reasons a Figure 3 node should not carry a compound name, both
# applied:
#
#   1. MSI level. L3 and L4 assignments are computational proposals; the name is
#      the best-matching candidate structure, not an identification. Printing it
#      on a figure asserts more than the data support. Only L1 and L2 features
#      (MSI_NAMEABLE) keep their name.
#   2. Biological implausibility. A handful of L1/L2 annotations are implausible
#      in an ombrotrophic bog regardless of the spectral evidence. Estriol is the
#      clearest case: it passes as L2 and is a mammalian steroid.
#
# Everything else is labelled by ClassyFire class plus the feature identifier, so
# the node is traceable to a row of Supplementary Data 10 without asserting a
# structure. The candidate name stays in Supplementary Data 10.
UNEXPECTED_ANNOTATIONS <- c(
  "Estriol", "17-Amino-5alpha-androstan-11-ol", "cis-Dehydroretinal",
  "Pfaffic acid", "Decarboxyhypothamnolic acid", "Ramalinic acid A")

# Two compound names are too long for a label box. Shortened for the figure
# only; the full name is in Supplementary Data 10. The kavalactone pair is the
# NAME_ALIASES diastereomer, so both features carry the same shortened label.
FIG3_NAME_SHORT <- c(
  "5-Hydroxy-4-methoxy-6-(2-phenylethyl)-5,6-dihydro-2H-pyran-2-one (stereochemistry unresolved)" =
    "Kavalactone\n(stereochemistry unresolved)")

# Some ClassyFire strings are too long to sit on a node. Shortened for the figure
# only; the full class is in Supplementary Data 10.
CLASS_LABEL_SHORT <- c(
  "Lignans, neolignans and related compounds" = "Lignan-like",
  "Steroids and steroid derivatives"          = "Steroid",
  "Prenol lipids"                             = "Prenol lipid",
  "Depsides and depsidones"                   = "Depsidone")

blankna <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | x %in% c("", "NA"), NA_character_, x)
class_label <- function(feature) {
  r <- df_metab[match(feature, df_metab$metabolite), , drop = FALSE]
  lab <- dplyr::coalesce(blankna(r$Subclass), blankna(r$Class),
                         blankna(r$Superclass))
  short <- unname(CLASS_LABEL_SHORT[lab])
  lab <- ifelse(is.na(short), lab, short)
  ifelse(is.na(lab), "unclassified feature", paste0(lab, " (putative)"))
}

metab_msi     <- setNames(df_metab$Annotation_Confidence, df_metab$metabolite)
metab_display <- unname(metab_lookup[vn])
is_metab      <- !(vn %in% all_MAGs)

short_hit <- !is.na(metab_display) & metab_display %in% names(FIG3_NAME_SHORT)
metab_display[short_hit] <- unname(FIG3_NAME_SHORT[metab_display[short_hit]])

msi_vn   <- unname(metab_msi[vn])
low_conf <- is_metab & (is.na(msi_vn) | !(msi_vn %in% MSI_NAMEABLE))
implaus  <- is_metab & !is.na(metab_display) &
            metab_display %in% UNEXPECTED_ANNOTATIONS
reclass  <- low_conf | implaus

reclass_reason <- dplyr::case_when(
  low_conf & implaus ~ "MSI L3/L4 and implausible in an ombrotrophic bog",
  low_conf           ~ "MSI L3/L4 or unannotated: name is a candidate structure",
  implaus            ~ "implausible in an ombrotrophic bog",
  TRUE               ~ NA_character_)

if (any(reclass)) {
  # Class on the first line, feature ID on the second, so the node stays
  # traceable to a row of Supplementary Data 10.
  metab_display[reclass] <- paste0(class_label(vn[reclass]), "\n", vn[reclass])
  cat(sprintf("  Figure 3: %d of %d metabolite label(s) replaced by class + feature ID\n",
              sum(reclass), sum(is_metab)))
  print(table(reclass_reason[reclass]))
}

# The network filter requires a non-missing Final_name, so this should never
# fire; if the filter is ever loosened, the node falls back to its feature ID
# rather than printing the string "NA".
no_label <- is_metab & is.na(metab_display)
if (any(no_label)) {
  warning(sum(no_label), " metabolite node(s) reached Figure 3 with no label; ",
          "using the feature ID.")
  metab_display[no_label] <- vn[no_label]
}

# Every metabolite label carries its MSI level, so a reader can see at a glance
# how much of the network rests on computational annotation.
msi_tag <- ifelse(is.na(msi_vn), "unannotated", msi_vn)
metab_display[is_metab] <- paste0(metab_display[is_metab], " [", msi_tag[is_metab], "]")

display_name <- ifelse(vn %in% all_MAGs, unname(mag_lookup[vn]), metab_display)
display_name[is.na(display_name)] <- vn[is.na(display_name)]

fermenter_ids <- c("SPRUCE 124", "SPRUCE 675")
all_levels <- c("Methanogen", "Warming-stimulated anoxic-preferring",
                "Warming-stimulated oxic-preferring", "Warming-inhibited",
                "Amino acids and derivatives", "Phenolic and polyphenolic compounds",
                "Lipids and derivatives", "Other organic compounds")
g_net <- set_vertex_attr(g_net, "group",        value = factor(node_group, levels = all_levels))
g_net <- set_vertex_attr(g_net, "node_type",    value = node_type)
g_net <- set_vertex_attr(g_net, "display_name", value = display_name)
g_net <- set_vertex_attr(g_net, "shape_group",  value = dplyr::case_when(
  vn %in% fermenter_ids ~ "Fermenter MAG", vn %in% all_MAGs ~ "MAG", TRUE ~ "Metabolite"))
print(table(node_group, useNA = "always"))

# Tripartite layout: genomes left, metabolites centre, methanogens right.
#
# The columns are pushed further apart than the node spacing needs, to open a
# gutter between the metabolite column and the methanogen column for the
# compound-name boxes. X_LABEL_RIGHT is the right edge every metabolite label
# is aligned to; the labels are right-justified there and grow leftward, so
# their right edges form a straight line whatever the name length.
X_MAG        <- -6
X_METAB      <-  0
X_METHANOGEN <-  6
X_LABEL_RIGHT <- 5.1     # right edge of the compound-name boxes
X_MAG_LABEL   <- -6.4    # MAG labels sit left of their column, right-aligned
X_METH_LABEL  <-  6.4    # methanogen labels sit right of theirs, left-aligned

# The metabolite column sets the vertical scale, because it has the most nodes
# and its labels are the two-line ones. METAB_ROW_GAP has to clear the height of
# a two-line box or the grey boxes overlap; it is the number to change if they
# ever do. The other two columns are then spread over the same total height, so
# the panel has no dead space and the MAG labels are not crowded.
METAB_ROW_GAP <- 2.1
y_half <- 0.5 * METAB_ROW_GAP * (sum(node_type == "Metabolite") - 1)

layout_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = vcount(g_net), ncol = 2, dimnames = list(vn, NULL))
for (grp in list(list(v = vn[node_type == "MAG" & !(vn %in% methanogens)], x = X_MAG),
                 list(v = vn[node_type == "Metabolite"],                   x = X_METAB),
                 list(v = vn[vn %in% methanogens],                         x = X_METHANOGEN))) {
  n <- length(grp$v)
  layout_mat[grp$v, 1] <- grp$x
  layout_mat[grp$v, 2] <- if (n == 1) 0 else seq(-y_half, y_half, length.out = n)
}

# Label frames, built off the same layout so a label can never drift from its
# node. Kept out of the graph object because their x is fixed by column, not by
# the node position, which is what makes the right edges line up.
lab_df <- data.frame(name = vn, y = layout_mat[vn, 2], label = display_name,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
lab_metab <- lab_df[node_type == "Metabolite", ]
lab_mag   <- lab_df[node_type == "MAG" & !(vn %in% methanogens), ]
lab_meth  <- lab_df[vn %in% methanogens, ]

node_colors <- c(
  "Methanogen" = "#D740F2", "Warming-stimulated anoxic-preferring" = "#CA9F01",
  "Warming-stimulated oxic-preferring" = "#538F6B", "Warming-inhibited" = "#0066CC",
  "Amino acids and derivatives" = "#E07040",
  "Phenolic and polyphenolic compounds" = "#7B3030",
  "Lipids and derivatives" = "#B8964A", "Other organic compounds" = "#999999")

FIG3 <- ggraph(g_net, layout = layout_mat[vn, ]) +
  geom_edge_link(aes(color = color), alpha = 0.6, width = 1.2) +
  scale_edge_color_identity() +
  geom_node_point(data = \(x) x[x$node_type == "Metabolite", ],
                  aes(fill = group, colour = shape_group), shape = 24, size = 5, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_node_point(data = \(x) x[x$node_type == "MAG" & !(x$name %in% fermenter_ids), ],
                  aes(fill = group, colour = shape_group), shape = 21, size = 8, stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_node_point(data = \(x) x[x$node_type == "MAG" & x$name %in% fermenter_ids, ],
                  aes(fill = group, colour = shape_group), shape = 22, size = 8, stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = node_colors, breaks = all_levels[1:4],
    name = "Genome classification",
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 2,
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 4, stroke = 0.8, color = "black"))) +
  # Compound names: grey box, placed in the gutter to the right of the
  # metabolite column, right-justified at X_LABEL_RIGHT so every box ends on the
  # same vertical line. The box is opaque so a name stays legible where an edge
  # runs under it. inherit.aes = FALSE keeps these off the node aesthetics.
  geom_label(data = lab_metab, inherit.aes = FALSE,
             aes(x = X_LABEL_RIGHT, y = y, label = label),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, lineheight = 0.95,
             colour = "grey15", fill = "grey90", alpha = 1,
             label.size = 0, label.r = unit(0.06, "lines"),
             label.padding = unit(0.16, "lines")) +
  # A leader from each metabolite node to its box, so a reader can follow a name
  # back to its triangle across the gutter.
  geom_segment(data = lab_metab, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = X_METAB + 0.12, xend = X_LABEL_RIGHT, y = y, yend = y),
               colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2, linetype = "dotted") +
  # MAGs and methanogens keep plain text, outside their own columns, so nothing
  # competes with the compound-name gutter.
  geom_text(data = lab_mag, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = X_MAG_LABEL, y = y, label = label),
            hjust = 1, size = 3.4, colour = "grey15") +
  geom_text(data = lab_meth, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = X_METH_LABEL, y = y, label = label),
            hjust = 0, size = 3.4, colour = "grey15") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(MAG = "black", `Fermenter MAG` = "black", Metabolite = "black"),
    name = "Node shape",
    guide = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(
      shape = c(21, 22, 24), size = c(4, 4, 3), fill = "grey60", stroke = 0.8, linetype = 0))) +
  # The label gutter and the two outer text columns sit outside the node
  # coordinates, so the panel has to be told to make room for them.
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(X_MAG_LABEL - 4.2, X_METH_LABEL + 4.2), clip = "off") +
  theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                       plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6))
save_fig(FIG3, p_net("Figure_3_network.pdf"), height = 14, width = 14)
save_fig(FIG3, p_fig("Figure_3_network.pdf"), height = 14, width = 14)

# ---- Supplementary Data 10 ----------------------------------------------------

# Each row is a genome-metabolite-methanogen path, so it spans two edges and
# carries two recovery frequencies. Edge keys are built the same way as in
# edge_stability above: the node pair sorted alphabetically and "|"-separated,
# so the join is on feature IDs and never on display names.
edge_key <- function(a, b) purrr::map2_chr(a, b, \(x, y) paste(sort(c(x, y)), collapse = "|"))

# What Figure 3 prints on each metabolite node, keyed on the feature ID. Carried
# into Supplementary Data 10 so that a claim in the Results can be traced from the
# figure label to the candidate name, the MSI level and the two edge recoveries
# without joining anything by hand.
fig3_label <- setNames(gsub("\n", " | ", metab_display[is_metab]), vn[is_metab])

Suppl_Data_10 <- connections_df |>
  mutate(connected_sensitive_tax = unname(mag_lookup[genome]),
         connected_methanogen    = methanogen,
         Metabolite_feature_ID   = metabolite,
         Metabolite_name         = unname(metab_lookup[metabolite]),
         Figure_3_label          = unname(fig3_label[metabolite]),
         key_genome_metab        = edge_key(genome,     metabolite),
         key_metab_methanogen    = edge_key(metabolite, methanogen)) |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(df_metab, metabolite, Kingdom, Superclass,
                          Class.metab = Class, Subclass, starts_with("Parent.Level")),
            by = "metabolite") |>
  # Mode, RT, m/z, MSI level and name multiplicity, so the network table carries
  # the same annotation bookkeeping as Supplementary Data 3 and 4.
  left_join(dplyr::select(taxdf_met, metabolite = feature, Acquisition_mode,
                          RT_min, precursor_mz, Annotation_Confidence,
                          Name_n_features, Name_status),
            by = "metabolite") |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(edge_stability,
                          key_genome_metab      = edge,
                          recovery_genome_metab = recovery_frequency),
            by = "key_genome_metab") |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(edge_stability,
                          key_metab_methanogen      = edge,
                          recovery_metab_methanogen = recovery_frequency),
            by = "key_metab_methanogen") |>
  mutate(Classification_network  = classify_metab(Superclass),
         edge_genome_metab       = sign_genome_metab,
         edge_metab_methanogen   = sign_metab_methanogen,
         weight_genome_metab     = round(weight_genome_metab, 4),
         weight_metab_methanogen = round(weight_metab_methanogen, 4)) |>
  dplyr::select(connected_sensitive_tax, connected_methanogen,
                Metabolite_feature_ID, Acquisition_mode, RT_min, precursor_mz,
                Metabolite_name, Figure_3_label, Annotation_Confidence,
                Name_n_features, Name_status,
                Kingdom, Superclass, Class.metab, Subclass, starts_with("Parent.Level"),
                Classification_network,
                edge_genome_metab,     weight_genome_metab,     recovery_genome_metab,
                edge_metab_methanogen, weight_metab_methanogen, recovery_metab_methanogen) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), \(x) na_if(x, ""))) |>
  arrange(connected_sensitive_tax, connected_methanogen, Metabolite_name)

# Every path edge must appear in edge_stability. An NA here means the Figure 3
# edge set and the resampling run have diverged, which the setequal guard above
# should already have caught.
if (anyNA(Suppl_Data_10$recovery_genome_metab) ||
    anyNA(Suppl_Data_10$recovery_metab_methanogen))
  stop("Supplementary Data 10: ",
       sum(is.na(Suppl_Data_10$recovery_genome_metab)), " genome-metabolite and ",
       sum(is.na(Suppl_Data_10$recovery_metab_methanogen)), " metabolite-methanogen ",
       "edge(s) have no recovery frequency. Rerun the resampling chunk.")

cat(sprintf("  Supplementary Data 10: %d paths, %d edge recovery values joined\n",
            nrow(Suppl_Data_10), 2 * nrow(Suppl_Data_10)))

write_out(Suppl_Data_10, p_net("Suppl_Data_10_linked_metabolites.csv"), na = "NA")
write_out(Suppl_Data_10, p_sd("Suppl_Data_10_linked_metabolites.csv"),  na = "NA")

# Network summary numbers quoted in the text and the Figure 3 legend.
fig3_summary <- data.frame(
    stars_stability      = getStability(se_FULL),
    edges_full           = sum(getRefit(se_FULL)) / 2,
    degree_threshold     = DEGREE_THRESHOLD,
    abundance_quantile   = ABUND_QUANTILE,
    n_MAGs_input         = ncol(mag_mat),
    n_metabolites_input  = ncol(met_mat),
    n_samples            = nrow(mag_mat),
    fig3_nodes           = vcount(g_net),
    fig3_edges           = ecount(g_net),
    n_connections        = nrow(connections_df),
    fig3_metabolites     = sum(is_metab),
    fig3_metab_named     = sum(is_metab & !reclass),
    fig3_metab_by_class  = sum(reclass),
    fig3_metab_L1        = sum(is_metab & msi_tag == "L1"),
    fig3_metab_L2        = sum(is_metab & msi_tag == "L2"),
    fig3_metab_L3        = sum(is_metab & msi_tag == "L3"),
    fig3_metab_L4        = sum(is_metab & msi_tag == "L4"),
    edge_recovery_median = median(edge_stability$recovery_frequency),
    edge_recovery_min    = min(edge_stability$recovery_frequency),
    edge_recovery_max    = max(edge_stability$recovery_frequency),
    resample_replicates  = RESAMPLE_N)
print(t(fig3_summary))
```

`Check_Fig3_edge_stability.csv` is produced by `resample_edge_recovery()`, defined
in `network-build` and called from `network-graph` whenever the stored file does
not describe the edge set actually plotted. It is not a separate chunk any more:
keeping the resampling code in one place is what stops the recovery frequencies
and the figure describing different graphs. The result is written back into
`00_inputs/` so that `WIPE_OUTPUTS` cannot delete it, and is reused on subsequent
knits for as long as the edge set is unchanged.

## 6. GENE-LEVEL RESULTS — Figure 4, Supplementary Figures S5, S6 and S7

Predictor names are used exactly as the Maaslin2 objects store them,
`AvgTemp10cm` and `WT_drawdown_cm`.

```{r gene-level-setup}

TEMP_GENE <- "AvgTemp10cm"
WT_GENE   <- "WT_drawdown_cm"

# Maaslin2 takes its feature names from taxa_names(); every join below is on the
# Gene column of the tax table. They have to be the same vector.
if (!identical(taxa_names(Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED),
               unname(as.character(tax_table(Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED)[, "Gene"]))))
  stop("taxa_names() and the Gene column of the gene tax table are not the same ",
       "vector. Every gene-level join below is on Gene and would return NA ",
       "annotations.")

subset_genes <- function(ids, camper_only = TRUE) {
  ps <- prune_taxa(rownames(tax_table(Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED))[
    tax_table(Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED)[, "SPRUCE_ID"] %in% ids], Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED)
  if (camper_only) ps <- subset_taxa(ps, CAMPER_id != "" & !is.na(CAMPER_id))
  ps
}
```

```{r fig4, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
# --- Figure 4: phenol-active gene responses in WS-OX and WS-AN genomes --------

read_gene_maaslin <- function(rds, ps) {
  tax <- data.frame(tax_table(ps))
  stopifnot("Gene" %in% names(tax))
  readRDS(rds)$results |>
    dplyr::rename(Gene = 1) |>
    add_effect_size() |>
    left_join(tax, by = "Gene")
}

ps_ox <- subset_genes(WSOX_IDS)
ps_an <- subset_genes(WSAN_IDS)
if (REFIT_MAASLIN) {
  fit_maaslin(ps_ox, "RE_Thermo_CAMPERgenes",     c("AvgTemp10cm", "WT_drawdown_cm"), "Plot")
  fit_maaslin(ps_an, "RE_ThermoANOX_CAMPERgenes", c("AvgTemp10cm", "WT_drawdown_cm"), "Plot")
}
df_Coef_Therm <- read_gene_maaslin(maaslin_path("RE_Thermo_CAMPERgenes.rds"),     ps_ox)
df_Coef_AN    <- read_gene_maaslin(maaslin_path("RE_ThermoANOX_CAMPERgenes.rds"), ps_an)
stopifnot(all(c(TEMP_GENE, WT_GENE) %in% df_Coef_Therm$metadata),
          all(c(TEMP_GENE, WT_GENE) %in% df_Coef_AN$metadata))

# Genes moving in one direction, per genome, per oxygen class, per predictor.
# The grid is built explicitly so a genome with no significant genes sits at (0, 0).
count_gene_responses <- function(df, direction = c("up", "down"), genomes = NULL) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  grid <- expand.grid(
    SPRUCE_ID     = if (is.null(genomes)) sort(unique(df$SPRUCE_ID)) else sort(genomes),
    metadata      = sort(unique(df$metadata)),
    CAMPER_oxygen = c("oxic", "anoxic"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df |>
    filter(pval < 0.05, if (direction == "up") coef > 0 else coef < 0,
           CAMPER_oxygen %in% c("oxic", "anoxic")) |>
    count(SPRUCE_ID, metadata, CAMPER_oxygen, name = "n_genes") |>
    right_join(grid, by = c("SPRUCE_ID", "metadata", "CAMPER_oxygen")) |>
    mutate(n_genes = tidyr::replace_na(n_genes, 0L)) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = CAMPER_oxygen, values_from = n_genes,
                       names_prefix = "genes_")
}

camper_scatter <- function(df, title, colors, axis_prefix, legend_pos = "none") {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = genes_oxic, y = genes_anoxic)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = taxonomy), colour = "black", pch = 21, size = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend("Genome", override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
    xlab(paste0("Oxygen-dependent genes\n", axis_prefix)) +
    ylab(paste0("Oxygen-independent genes\n", axis_prefix)) +
    ggtitle(title) + theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = legend_pos, axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16))
}

add_taxonomy <- function(counts, tax) {
  counts |>
    left_join(distinct(dplyr::select(tax, SPRUCE_ID, Phylum, Genus)), by = "SPRUCE_ID") |>
    mutate(taxonomy = paste0(SPRUCE_ID, ": ", Phylum,
                             ifelse(Genus == "" | is.na(Genus), "", paste0(" g__", Genus))))
}

FIG4B_GENOMES <- c("SPRUCE 124", "SPRUCE 2057", "SPRUCE 2060", "SPRUCE 2148",
                   "SPRUCE 2155", "SPRUCE 2191", "SPRUCE 275")
if (length(setdiff(FIG4B_GENOMES, df_Coef_AN$SPRUCE_ID)))
  warning("Figure 4B genomes absent from the WS-AN results: ",
          paste(setdiff(FIG4B_GENOMES, df_Coef_AN$SPRUCE_ID), collapse = ", "))

genes_df_OX <- add_taxonomy(count_gene_responses(df_Coef_Therm, "up", WSOX_IDS),
                            data.frame(tax_table(ps_ox)))
genes_df_AN <- add_taxonomy(count_gene_responses(df_Coef_AN, "up", FIG4B_GENOMES),
                            data.frame(tax_table(ps_an)))

green   <- scico(max(7, n_distinct(genes_df_OX$taxonomy)), palette = "bamako")
yellows <- c("#663329","#A54543","#D85F4D","#E48751","#ECAC54","#F7D971","#FFFECB")

fig4a_A <- camper_scatter(filter(genes_df_OX, metadata == WT_GENE),   "Water table drawdown", green, "increasing")
fig4a_B <- camper_scatter(filter(genes_df_OX, metadata == TEMP_GENE), "Temperature",          green, "increasing", "right")
save_legend(fig4a_B, legend_path(p_fig("Figure_4A_WSOX_phenolic_genes.pdf")), width = 3.5, height = 5)
save_fig(ggarrange(fig4a_A, fig4a_B + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    ncol = 2, labels = c("A","B"), font.label = list(size = 18)),
  p_fig("Figure_4A_WSOX_phenolic_genes.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)

fig4b_A <- camper_scatter(filter(genes_df_AN, metadata == WT_GENE),   "Water table drawdown", yellows, "increasing")
fig4b_B <- camper_scatter(filter(genes_df_AN, metadata == TEMP_GENE), "Temperature",          yellows, "increasing", "right")
save_legend(fig4b_B, legend_path(p_fig("Figure_4B_WSAN_phenolic_genes.pdf")), width = 3.5, height = 5)
save_fig(ggarrange(fig4b_A, fig4b_B + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    ncol = 2, labels = c("A","B"), font.label = list(size = 18)),
  p_fig("Figure_4B_WSAN_phenolic_genes.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)

# Gene counts quoted in the Results.
cat("\nWS-OX upregulated phenol-active genes by predictor:\n")
print(genes_df_OX |> group_by(metadata) |>
        summarise(total = sum(genes_oxic + genes_anoxic), .groups = "drop"))
cat("WS-OX downregulated:\n")
print(count_gene_responses(df_Coef_Therm, "down", WSOX_IDS) |> group_by(metadata) |>
        summarise(total = sum(genes_oxic + genes_anoxic), .groups = "drop"))
cat("WS-AN upregulated:\n")
print(genes_df_AN |> group_by(metadata) |>
        summarise(total = sum(genes_oxic + genes_anoxic), .groups = "drop"))

# Supplementary Data 12 and 13: the gene-level tables behind Figure 4.
write_out(filter(df_Coef_Therm, pval < 0.05) |> arrange(metadata, pval),
          p_sd("Suppl_Data_12_WSOX_CAMPER_genes.csv"))
write_out(filter(df_Coef_AN,    pval < 0.05) |> arrange(metadata, pval),
          p_sd("Suppl_Data_13_WSAN_CAMPER_genes.csv"))
```

```{r fig-s-aminocarb, fig.width=12, fig.height=15}
Select_taxa <- read.csv(net_path("Linking_Metabolites_INFO.csv")) |>

# Three genes, each in a pathway enriched in Figure 5: K00382 (dihydrolipoyl

subset_data_df_plot <- subset_genes(Select_taxa, camper_only = FALSE) |>

  filter(ko_id %in% target_ko) |>
  group_by(SPRUCE_ID, ko_id, pfam_hits, Phylum, Genus, Year, AvgTemp10cm,

  dplyr::summarise(mean_Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(taxonomy = paste0(SPRUCE_ID, ": ", Phylum, " g__", Genus), Year = as.factor(Year))

colors_aminocarb <- c("#663329","#A54543","#D85F4D","#E48751","#ECAC54","#F7D971","#FFFECB",
                       "#003A46","#15483A","#355E26","#988C02","#D0B74B","#FFE5AC","#C5DBA0")

save_fig(
  merge(expand.grid(taxonomy = unique(subset_data_df_plot$taxonomy), ko_id = target_ko),
        subset_data_df_plot, by = c("taxonomy","ko_id"), all.x = TRUE) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = AvgTemp10cm, y = mean_Abundance)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = taxonomy, shape = Year), colour = "black", size = 5, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~taxonomy + ko_id, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_aminocarb) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24)) +
    xlab("Temperature (ºC, May-Aug)") +
    ylab("Relative activity of gene\n(TAD80/ribosomal expression)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16), strip.text = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank()),
  p_fig("Figure_S6_central_metabolism_genes.pdf"), height = 15, width = 12)

compound_class <- data.frame(tax_table(metabolites_phylo))

# Three panels: peptides, free amino acids, carbohydrates. ClassyFire files
# peptides and free amino acids together under the class "Carboxylic acids and
# derivatives", so grouping by Class would merge the first two panels. The split
# is taken at Parent.Level.1, matching the class-level tests in section 2.9.5,
# and the panels are ordered so the peptide result and the free amino acid null
# sit next to each other.
if (!all(c("Parent.Level.1", "Subclass") %in% names(compound_class)))
  stop("The metabolite tax table needs Parent.Level.1 and Subclass to build the ",
       "peptide, amino acid and carbohydrate panels of Supplementary Figure S7.")
compound_class$Metab_set <- dplyr::case_when(
  compound_class$Parent.Level.1 %in% "Peptides"                            ~ "Peptides",
  compound_class$Parent.Level.1 %in% "Amino acids and derivatives"         ~ "Amino acids",
  compound_class$Subclass %in% "Carbohydrates and carbohydrate conjugates" ~ "Carbohydrates",
  TRUE                                                                     ~ NA_character_)
cat("\nSupplementary Figure S7 features: peptides",
    sum(compound_class$Metab_set %in% "Peptides"),
    "| amino acids", sum(compound_class$Metab_set %in% "Amino acids"),
    "| carbohydrates", sum(compound_class$Metab_set %in% "Carbohydrates"), "\n")

amino_carb_summary <- {
  met_norm <- sample_matrix(metabolites_phylo)
  met_norm <- met_norm / rowMeans(met_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
  met_norm$SampleID <- rownames(met_norm)
  met_norm
} |>
  left_join(data.frame(sample_data(metabolites_phylo)) |>
              dplyr::select(SampleID = Sample, AvgTemp10cm, Warming_Treatment.ord,
                            Year, WT_drawdown_cm),
            by = "SampleID") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(SampleID, AvgTemp10cm, Warming_Treatment.ord, Year, WT_drawdown_cm),
               names_to = "Feature", values_to = "NormalizedIntensity") |>
  inner_join(filter(compound_class, !is.na(Metab_set)), by = "Feature") |>
  group_by(SampleID, AvgTemp10cm, Warming_Treatment.ord, Year, WT_drawdown_cm, Metab_set) |>
  dplyr::summarise(MeanIntensity = mean(NormalizedIntensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Metab_set = factor(Metab_set,
                            levels = c("Peptides", "Amino acids", "Carbohydrates")),
         Year      = as.factor(Year))

if (nrow(amino_carb_summary) == 0)
  stop("No peptide, amino acid or carbohydrate feature matched the tax table. ",
       "Check that make.names() has not altered the feature IDs.")
if (dplyr::n_distinct(amino_carb_summary$Metab_set) != 3)
  stop("Supplementary Figure S7 expects three panels; found: ",
       paste(levels(droplevels(amino_carb_summary$Metab_set)), collapse = ", "))

save_fig(
  ggplot(amino_carb_summary, aes(x = AvgTemp10cm, y = MeanIntensity, shape = Year)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Warming_Treatment.ord), size = 8, colour = "black") +
    geom_smooth(aes(linetype = Year), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~Metab_set) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = allGroupsColors) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("2020" = "solid","2021" = "dashed","2022" = "dotted")) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend("Temperature\ntreatment", override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
    labs(x = "Temperature at 10 cm (May-Aug, °C)", y = "Mean Normalized Intensity") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16), strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
          strip.background = element_blank()),
  p_fig("Figure_S7_peptide_amino_acid_carbohydrate.pdf"), width = 14, height = 5)

aa_carb_models <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  list("Peptides (set mean intensity)"                             = "Peptides",
       "Amino acids, free, peptides excluded (set mean intensity)" = "Amino acids",
       "Carbohydrates (set mean intensity)"                        = "Carbohydrates"),
  \(cls, nm) {
    m <- stats::step(lm(MeanIntensity ~ AvgTemp10cm * WT_drawdown_cm,
                        data = filter(amino_carb_summary, Metab_set == cls)), trace = 0)
    s <- summary(m)
    data.frame(response = nm, formula = paste(deparse(formula(m)), collapse = " "),
               term = rownames(s$coefficients), s$coefficients,
               adj_R2 = s$adj.r.squared, n = nobs(m), row.names = NULL)
  })
# Printed as a cross-check only; the reported values come from the class-mean
# mixed models above.
print(aa_carb_models)
```

## 7. KEGG PATHWAY ENRICHMENT — Figure 5 (EXPLORATORY)

Exploratory. The gene-level tests behind the query set are close to, or below,
the 5% null expectation, and the chunk prints the counts it is based on.
`universe` is the set of KO IDs detected in these genomes. Correction is `holm`,
with BH reported alongside.

```{r clusterprofiler-fig5, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}

Select_taxa_net <- read.csv(net_path("Linking_Metabolites_INFO.csv")) |>
  pull(genome) |> unique() |> setdiff(c("SPRUCE 190", "SPRUCE 689"))
Thermo_ox_net.genes.ps <- subset_genes(Select_taxa_net, camper_only = FALSE)
taxdf_net <- data.frame(tax_table(Thermo_ox_net.genes.ps))

if (REFIT_MAASLIN && REFIT_LARGE) {
  fit_maaslin(Thermo_ox_net.genes.ps, "RE_networked_ALL",
              fixed = "AvgTemp10cm", random = "Plot")
}
MaAslinLM_net <- readRDS(maaslin_path("RE_networked_ALL.rds"))
df_Coef_net   <- MaAslinLM_net$results |> dplyr::rename(Gene = 1) |>
  add_effect_size() |> left_join(taxdf_net, by = "Gene")
stopifnot(TEMP_GENE %in% df_Coef_net$metadata)

n_tested <- nrow(filter(df_Coef_net, metadata == TEMP_GENE))
n_p05    <- sum(df_Coef_net$metadata == TEMP_GENE & df_Coef_net$pval < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Gene-level: %d tested, %d at P<0.05 (%.1f%%, null expectation 5%%), min q = %.3f\n",
            n_tested, n_p05, 100 * n_p05 / n_tested,
            min(df_Coef_net$qval[df_Coef_net$metadata == TEMP_GENE], na.rm = TRUE)))

df_ko <- df_Coef_net |>
  filter(metadata == TEMP_GENE, !is.na(ko_id), !ko_id %in% c("", "NA")) |>
  mutate(diffexpressed = case_when(coef > 0 & pval < 0.05 ~ "Warm",
                                   coef < 0 & pval < 0.05 ~ "Ambient",
                                   TRUE ~ "NO"))

KO_UNIVERSE <- unique(df_ko$ko_id)
cat("Background universe:", length(KO_UNIVERSE), "unique KO IDs\n")

pathways   <- keggList("pathway", "ko")
kegg_names <- data.frame(
  ID          = sub("path:", "", names(pathways)),
  Description = sub(" - Reference pathway", "", pathways),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
TERM2GENE <- clusterProfiler::download_KEGG("ko")$KEGGPATHID2EXTID |>
  dplyr::select(term = from, gene = to) |>
  left_join(kegg_names, by = c("term" = "ID")) |>
  mutate(term = Description) |>
  dplyr::select(term, gene) |>
  filter(!is.na(term))

ora <- clusterProfiler::enricher(
  gene          = df_ko$ko_id[df_ko$diffexpressed == "Warm"],
  universe      = KO_UNIVERSE,
  TERM2GENE     = TERM2GENE,
  pAdjustMethod = "holm",
  pvalueCutoff  = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1)

if (is.null(ora) || nrow(ora@result) == 0)
  stop("enricher() returned nothing. Check that ko_id values match TERM2GENE.")
res_df <- ora@result |>
  mutate(p_adjust_BH = p.adjust(pvalue, "BH"), p_adjust_holm = p.adjust(pvalue, "holm"))
print(head(res_df[order(res_df$pvalue), c("ID","Description","Count","pvalue","p_adjust_BH","p_adjust_holm")], 20), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Pathways at raw P<0.05 and >=10 genes:",
    sum(res_df$pvalue < 0.05 & res_df$Count >= 10), "\n")
cat("Surviving Holm P<0.05:", sum(res_df$p_adjust_holm < 0.05), "\n")
cat("Surviving BH q<0.05:  ", sum(res_df$p_adjust_BH   < 0.05), "\n")

res_df_filt <- filter(res_df, pvalue < 0.05, Count >= 10)

if (nrow(res_df_filt) == 0) {
  warning("No KEGG pathway passes the Figure 5 display filter.")
} else {
  FIG5 <- ggplot(arrange(res_df_filt, desc(Count)),
                 aes(x = fct_reorder(Description, Count), y = Count, fill = pvalue)) +
    geom_col() + coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient(name = "P-value", high = "#9ecae1", low = "#08306b") +
    labs(x = "KEGG Pathway", y = "Number of genes with increased transcription",
         caption = paste0("Exploratory. Query set defined at nominal P < 0.05; ",
                          n_p05, "/", n_tested, " genes (",
                          sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n_p05 / n_tested),
                          ") reach that threshold, against a 5% null expectation.")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0))
  save_fig(FIG5, p_fig("Figure_5_KEGG_enrichment.pdf"), height = 8, width = 10)
}

# --- Supplementary Data 14 ---------------------------------------------------
Suppl_Data_14 <- arrange(df_Coef_net, metadata, pval)
cat("Supplementary Data 14: ", nrow(Suppl_Data_14), " rows, ",
    sum(Suppl_Data_14$pval < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), " at P<0.05\n", sep = "")
if (sum(Suppl_Data_14$pval < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
  stop("Supplementary Data 14 contains no gene at P < 0.05.")
write_out(Suppl_Data_14, p_sd("Suppl_Data_14_networked_genes.csv"))
```

## 9. METHANOGEN ACTIVITY — Figure 6

```{r methanogen, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}

# --- Supplementary Figure S8 --------------------------------------------------

matching_mcrA <- rownames(tax_table(Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED))[
  tax_table(Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED)[, "ko_id"] %in% "K00399"]
methanogen_gene_ps <- prune_taxa(
  intersect(matching_mcrA, rownames(tax_table(subset_genes(METHANOGEN_IDS, FALSE)))),
  Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED)
active_mcrA <- unique(data.frame(tax_table(methanogen_gene_ps))$SPRUCE_ID)
cat("Methanogen MAGs expressing mcrA:", paste(active_mcrA, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# --- Share of mcrA expression held by the four oxygen-sensitive methanogens ----
# Denominator: every gene annotated K00399 in any MAG. Numerator: the K00399
# genes in METHANOGEN_IDS. Abundance is ribosome-normalised gene activity.

mcrA_all_ps <- prune_taxa(matching_mcrA, Genes_withMAG_NORMALIZED)

mcrA_share <- psmelt(mcrA_all_ps) |>
  dplyr::mutate(is_methanogen = SPRUCE_ID %in% METHANOGEN_IDS) |>
  dplyr::group_by(SPRUCE_ID, is_methanogen) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_activity = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_genes        = dplyr::n_distinct(OTU),
                   n_samples_nonzero = sum(Abundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_activity)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct_of_total = 100 * total_activity / sum(total_activity))

MCRA_PCT_METHANOGENS <- sum(mcrA_share$pct_of_total[mcrA_share$is_methanogen])

cat(sprintf(
  "mcrA (K00399): %d genes across %d MAGs. The %d methanogen MAGs hold %.1f%% of total normalised mcrA activity.\n",
  length(matching_mcrA), nrow(mcrA_share), sum(mcrA_share$is_methanogen),
  MCRA_PCT_METHANOGENS))

if (nrow(mcrA_share) > sum(mcrA_share$is_methanogen))
  cat("  Non-methanogen MAGs carrying K00399: ",
      paste(mcrA_share$SPRUCE_ID[!mcrA_share$is_methanogen], collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")

print(as.data.frame(mcrA_share), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)


df_Meth_PW <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(droughtMAG.activity.ps) %in% active_mcrA,
                         droughtMAG.activity.ps) |>
  psmelt() |>
  mutate(WT_drawdown_cm = WT_drawdown * 100, Year = as.factor(Year), Plot = as.factor(Plot)) |>
  group_by(Warming, Year, Plot, AvgTemp10cm, Temp_avg_top, WT_drawdown_cm,
           Warming_Treatment.ord) |>
  dplyr::summarize(sum_Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(PWgas_sub, Year, Plot, CH4mM), by = c("Year", "Plot")) |>
  filter(!is.na(CH4mM))

model_meth_CH4 <- glmmTMB(CH4mM ~ sum_Abundance + (1 | Plot), family = gaussian(),
                          data = df_Meth_PW)
meth_fix <- drop_singular_re(model_meth_CH4, df_Meth_PW, "CH4 ~ methanogen activity")
register_model(tidy_glmmtmb(meth_fix$model, "Porewater CH4 ~ total methanogen activity"))
print(tidy_glmmtmb(meth_fix$model, "Porewater CH4 ~ total methanogen activity"))

save_fig(
  ggplot(df_Meth_PW, aes(x = sum_Abundance, y = CH4mM)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Warming_Treatment.ord), colour = "black", size = 8, pch = 21) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = allGroupsColors) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend("Temperature\ntreatment", override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +
    xlab("Total relative activity of methanogens") + ylab("Porewater CH4 (mM)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16)),
  p_fig("Figure_S8_methanogen_activity.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)

# --- Annual CH4 emission by year, Supplementary Data 1 and Figure S8C ---------
# Modelled annual emission per enclosure from Cory et al. (2025). Restricted to
# the ten study enclosures and the three sampled years, and fitted on the log
# scale because emission spans more than an order of magnitude between enclosures.
#
# Temperature enters as a fixed effect. Warming is assigned per enclosure, so a
# year-only model with (1|Plot) hides the whole warming gradient inside the
# random intercept: enclosure variance falls from 0.46 to 0.05 once temperature
# is fitted, meaning most of what separates enclosures is the treatment. The
# year by temperature interaction is kept when the LRT supports it, as elsewhere.
#
# Year is referenced to 2021, the drought year, because the contrasts the text
# discusses are the drop into 2021 and the recovery out of it. Referenced to 2020
# the 2022 coefficient tests 2022 against 2020, which is not that comparison.

CH4_flux_annual <- readr::read_csv(p_raw_req(CH4_FLUX_CSV), show_col_types = FALSE,
                                   name_repair = "minimal") |>
  rlang::set_names(c("Year", "Plot", "CH4_flux")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Year     = suppressWarnings(as.integer(Year)),
                CH4_flux = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CH4_flux)),
                Plot     = suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^P0*", "", Plot)))) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Year), !is.na(CH4_flux), !is.na(Plot),
                Year %in% c(2020, 2021, 2022), Plot %in% STUDY_PLOTS) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    # Plot and Year are factors in metadata_df, so they are taken back through
    # as.character(); as.integer() on a factor returns the level index.
    dplyr::select(metadata_df, Plot, Year, Temp_avg_top, WT_drawdown_cm) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Plot = as.integer(as.character(Plot)),
                    Year = as.integer(as.character(Year))) |>
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = c("Plot", "Year")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Year          = factor(Year, levels = c(2021, 2020, 2022)),
                Plot          = as.factor(Plot),
                log_CH4_flux  = log(CH4_flux),
                # Centred so that with the interaction in the model the Year
                # coefficients are year contrasts at the mean temperature of the
                # experiment rather than extrapolations to 0 degrees.
                Temp_c        = Temp_avg_top - mean(Temp_avg_top))

if (anyNA(CH4_flux_annual$Temp_avg_top))
  stop("Temperature is missing for ", sum(is.na(CH4_flux_annual$Temp_avg_top)),
       " enclosure-year(s) in the flux table.")
if (nrow(CH4_flux_annual) != dplyr::n_distinct(CH4_flux_annual$Plot,
                                               CH4_flux_annual$Year))
  stop("The metadata join duplicated enclosure-years in the flux table.")

cat(sprintf("Annual CH4 flux: %d enclosure-years across %d enclosures and %d years\n",
            nrow(CH4_flux_annual), dplyr::n_distinct(CH4_flux_annual$Plot),
            dplyr::n_distinct(CH4_flux_annual$Year)))
print(CH4_flux_annual |>
        dplyr::group_by(Year) |>
        dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
                         median_flux = median(CH4_flux),
                         .groups = "drop") |>
        as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)

FLUX_LABEL <- "Annual CH4 flux ~ year x temperature (log scale)"
flux_lrt <- lrt_interaction(log_CH4_flux ~ Year * Temp_c + (1 | Plot),
                            log_CH4_flux ~ Year + Temp_c + (1 | Plot),
                            CH4_flux_annual, label = "Annual CH4 flux")
cat("Mean temperature used for centring: ",
    round(mean(CH4_flux_annual$Temp_avg_top), 2), " C\n", sep = "")
flux_fix <- drop_singular_re(flux_lrt$model, CH4_flux_annual, FLUX_LABEL)
register_model(tidy_glmmtmb(flux_fix$model, FLUX_LABEL))
print(tidy_glmmtmb(flux_fix$model, FLUX_LABEL))

# Year-only fit, kept as a reference point for how much of the between-enclosure
# variation the warming treatment accounts for.
flux_yearonly <- glmmTMB(log_CH4_flux ~ Year + (1 | Plot), family = gaussian(),
                         data = CH4_flux_annual)
cat("Enclosure SD, year only: ",
    signif(attr(VarCorr(flux_yearonly)$cond$Plot, "stddev")[1], 3),
    " | with temperature: ",
    signif(tryCatch(attr(VarCorr(flux_fix$model)$cond$Plot, "stddev")[1],
                    error = function(e) NA_real_), 3), "\n", sep = "")

# Back-transform each year contrast to a percentage change against 2021, the
# drought year, evaluated at the mean temperature of the experiment.
flux_coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(flux_fix$model)$coefficients$cond)
colnames(flux_coefs) <- c("Estimate", "Std_Error", "z_value", "p_value")
flux_coefs$term <- rownames(flux_coefs)
for (yr in grep("^Year", flux_coefs$term, value = TRUE))
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %+.1f%% relative to 2021 (P = %.3g)\n", yr,
              100 * (exp(flux_coefs$Estimate[flux_coefs$term == yr]) - 1),
              flux_coefs$p_value[flux_coefs$term == yr]))

# --- Unadjusted year-to-year contrasts, paired within enclosure ---------------
# The model above compares years at a common temperature. Ambient temperature
# also differed between years, so the two questions have different answers and
# the manuscript states both. These are the raw contrasts: each enclosure is its
# own control, which is the right pairing for a balanced 10 x 3 design and does
# not pool one residual variance across the drought year and the wet years.

flux_wide <- CH4_flux_annual |>
  dplyr::select(Plot, Year, log_CH4_flux) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = log_CH4_flux,
                     names_prefix = "y")
temp_wide <- CH4_flux_annual |>
  dplyr::select(Plot, Year, Temp_avg_top) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = Temp_avg_top,
                     names_prefix = "y")

flux_year_contrasts <- purrr::map_dfr(
  list(c("y2020", "y2021"), c("y2022", "y2021"), c("y2022", "y2020")),
  function(pr) {
    a <- flux_wide[[pr[1]]]; b <- flux_wide[[pr[2]]]
    tt <- stats::t.test(a, b, paired = TRUE)
    data.frame(
      contrast          = paste(sub("^y", "", pr[1]), "vs", sub("^y", "", pr[2])),
      n_enclosures      = length(a),
      mean_log_diff     = unname(tt$estimate),
      percent_change    = 100 * (exp(unname(tt$estimate)) - 1),
      t                 = unname(tt$statistic),
      p_value           = tt$p.value,
      n_higher          = sum(a > b),
      temp_diff_C       = mean(temp_wide[[pr[1]]]) - mean(temp_wide[[pr[2]]]))
  })
cat("\n=== Annual CH4 flux, unadjusted paired contrasts ===\n")
print(flux_year_contrasts, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)

CH4_flux_annual$Year_display <- factor(as.character(CH4_flux_annual$Year),
                                       levels = c("2020", "2021", "2022"))
save_fig(
  ggplot(CH4_flux_annual, aes(x = Year_display, y = CH4_flux)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey92") +
    geom_line(aes(group = Plot), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(size = 5, pch = 21, fill = "grey40", colour = "black") +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression(paste("Annual C", H[4], " flux (", mu,
                                        "mol ", m^-2, " ", y^-1, ")"))) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16)),
  p_fig("Figure_S8C_methane_flux.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5)

# --- Figure 6A: mcrA per MAG --------------------------------------------------
# Full models, no term elimination. Zero-inflation term for MAGs with >20% zeros.

df_sensitive.mcrA <- psmelt(methanogen_gene_ps) |>
  mutate(WT_drawdown_cm = WT_drawdown * 100, Year = as.factor(Year), Plot = as.factor(Plot))

df_sensitive.mcrA |>
  group_by(SPRUCE_ID) |>
  summarise(n = n(), n_zero = sum(Abundance == 0),
            pct_zero = round(mean(Abundance == 0) * 100, 1), .groups = "drop") |>
  print()

mcrA_table <- purrr::map_dfr(unique(df_sensitive.mcrA$SPRUCE_ID), function(sid) {
  d  <- filter(df_sensitive.mcrA, SPRUCE_ID == sid)
  zi <- mean(d$Abundance == 0) >= 0.2
  m  <- glmmTMB(Abundance ~ Temp_avg_top * WT_drawdown_cm + (1 | Plot),
                ziformula = if (zi) ~ WT_drawdown_cm else ~0,
                family = gaussian(link = "identity"), data = d)
  out <- tidy_glmmtmb(m, sid) |> mutate(component = "conditional", model_type = if (zi) "ZIGA" else "Gaussian")
  if (zi) {
    z <- as.data.frame(summary(m)$coefficients$zi)
    colnames(z) <- c("Estimate","Std_Error","z_value","p_value")
    out <- bind_rows(out, data.frame(
      response = sid, formula = paste(deparse(formula(m)), collapse = " "), n = nobs(m),
      z, term = paste0("ZI:", rownames(z)), sig = "", R2_marginal = NA, R2_conditional = NA,
      singular_fit = any(is.nan(z$Std_Error)), component = "zero-inflation",
      model_type = "ZIGA", row.names = NULL))
  }
  out
})

# Flag coefficients whose standard error swamps the estimate.
mcrA_table <- mcrA_table |>
  mutate(unstable = is.na(Std_Error) |
                    (!is.na(Estimate) & Std_Error > 100 * abs(Estimate)))
if (any(mcrA_table$unstable))
  warning("Unstable mcrA coefficients (SE >> estimate): ",
          paste(unique(mcrA_table$response[mcrA_table$unstable]), collapse = ", "))
print(mcrA_table)
write_out(mcrA_table, p_sd("Suppl_Data_16_mcrA_models.csv"))

df_sensitive.mcrA$taxonomy <- paste0(df_sensitive.mcrA$SPRUCE_ID, ": ", df_sensitive.mcrA$Phylum)
save_fig(
  ggplot(df_sensitive.mcrA, aes(x = WT_drawdown_cm, y = Abundance)) +
    facet_wrap(~taxonomy, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Warming_Treatment.ord, shape = Year), colour = "black", size = 5) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24)) + scale_fill_manual(values = allGroupsColors) +
    xlab("Water table drawdown (cm)") +
    ylab("Relative activity mcrA\n(TAD80/ribosomal expression)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16), strip.text = element_text(size = 12)),
  p_fig("Figure_6A_mcrA_water_table.pdf"), height = 6, width = 7)

# --- Figure 6B: methanogen phenol-active genes decreasing ---------------------
# Four genomes. Effective n is 4, not the number of genes.

ps_meth <- subset_genes(METHANOGEN_IDS)
if (REFIT_MAASLIN) {
  fit_maaslin(ps_meth, "RE_Methano_campergenes",
              fixed = c("AvgTemp10cm", "WT_drawdown_cm"), random = "Plot")
}
df_Coef_Meth <- read_gene_maaslin(maaslin_path("RE_Methano_campergenes.rds"), ps_meth)
stopifnot(all(c(TEMP_GENE, WT_GENE) %in% df_Coef_Meth$metadata))
cat("Methanogen CAMPER genes: ", nrow(df_Coef_Meth), " tests, ",
    sum(df_Coef_Meth$coef < 0), " negative coefficients, across ",
    n_distinct(df_Coef_Meth$SPRUCE_ID), " genomes\n", sep = "")

genes_df_meth <- add_taxonomy(count_gene_responses(df_Coef_Meth, "down", METHANOGEN_IDS),
                              data.frame(tax_table(ps_meth)))
pink <- scico(max(5, n_distinct(genes_df_meth$taxonomy)), palette = "acton")

fig6b_A <- camper_scatter(filter(genes_df_meth, metadata == TEMP_GENE), "Temperature",
                          pink, "decreasing")
fig6b_B <- camper_scatter(filter(genes_df_meth, metadata == WT_GENE),   "Water table drawdown",
                          pink, "decreasing", "right")
save_legend(fig6b_B, legend_path(p_fig("Figure_6B_methanogen_phenolic_genes.pdf")),
            width = 3.5, height = 5)
save_fig(ggarrange(fig6b_A, fig6b_B + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    ncol = 2, labels = c("A","B"), font.label = list(size = 18)),
  p_fig("Figure_6B_methanogen_phenolic_genes.pdf"), width = 10, height = 4)

write_out(filter(df_Coef_Meth, pval < 0.05) |> arrange(metadata, pval),
          p_sd("Suppl_Data_17_methanogen_CAMPER_genes.csv"))
```

## 10. SUPPLEMENTARY DATA 1 AND 2 — MODEL COEFFICIENT TABLES

Every `glmmTMB` fit registers itself in `MODEL_TABLE` with the formula it fitted.

```{r stat-summary-tables}

all_models <- bind_rows(MODEL_TABLE)

env_responses <- c("Porewater CH4 (mM)", "Porewater CO2 (mM)", "Porewater CO2:CH4 ratio",
                   "Gallic-acid-equivalent reducing capacity",
                   "Porewater CH4 ~ total methanogen activity",
                   "Annual CH4 flux ~ year x temperature (log scale)")
write_out(filter(all_models, response %in% env_responses |
                             grepl("^Sample NOSC", response)),
          p_sd("Suppl_Data_01_environmental_models.csv"))
write_out(filter(all_models, grepl("glucosidase|Cellobiohydrolase|acetylglucosaminidase|phosphatase|Phenol oxidase",
                                   response)),
          p_sd("Suppl_Data_02_enzyme_models.csv"))

if (any(all_models$singular_fit, na.rm = TRUE))
  warning("Singular fits present: ",
          paste(unique(all_models$response[all_models$singular_fit]), collapse = ", "))
```

```{r readme-and-manifest}
  "Suppl_Data_13_WSAN_CAMPER_genes.csv",       "Suppl_Data_14_networked_genes.csv",
  "Suppl_Data_15_methanogen_pathways.csv",     "Suppl_Data_16_mcrA_models.csv",
  "Suppl_Data_17_methanogen_CAMPER_genes.csv", "Suppl_Data_18_annotation_citations.csv",
  "Suppl_Data_03_04_column_definitions.csv")

manifest <- data.frame(
  file    = expected,
  present = file.exists(p_sd(expected)),
  rows    = vapply(p_sd(expected),
                   \(f) if (file.exists(f)) nrow(readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE))
                        else NA_integer_, integer(1)))
print(manifest, row.names = FALSE)

if (any(!manifest$present))
  warning("Missing supplementary data: ",
          paste(manifest$file[!manifest$present], collapse = ", "))

writeLines(paste0(
"# SPRUCE Drought Manuscript Analysis Code

Manuscript: Combined effects of warming and drought accelerate microbially
mediated organic matter decomposition and suppress methanogenesis in peatlands
Authors: Katherine Duchesneau et al.
Journal: Nature Communications, NCOMMS-26-018889-T
Code DOI (Zenodo): 10.5281/zenodo.19865237

## How to run

1. Open `Drought_R_analyses.Rproj`.
2. Set `PROJ` at the top of `Drought_Manuscript_Analysis.Rmd` to your local
   path. It is the only absolute path in the document.
3. Knit `Drought_Manuscript_Analysis.Rmd`. It runs top to bottom and reads
   nothing from outside `2Revisions_out/00_inputs/`.

## Run switches, all at the top of the setup chunk

REFIT_MAASLIN   refit every Maaslin2 model from the phyloseq objects
REFIT_LARGE     also refit the two large gene models (hours to overnight)
MAASLIN_CACHE   skip a refit when the stored fit matches the same inputs
RUN_NETWORK     TRUE fits SpiecEasi, FALSE reloads 08_network/se_FULL.RDS
RESAMPLE_N      replicate count behind the Figure 3 edge-recovery input
RUN_RESAMPLE    TRUE recomputes edge recovery when the plotted edge set no
                longer matches 00_inputs/Check_Fig3_edge_stability.csv;
                FALSE stops the knit
WIPE_OUTPUTS    delete 01_ to 08_ before the run; 00_inputs is never touched

## Files

Drought_Manuscript_Analysis.Rmd   all analyses, figures and tables
Drought_R_analyses.Rproj          RStudio project

## Folders

2Revisions_out/   the whole analysis, inputs and outputs
  00_inputs/      every file the Rmd reads
  01_metadata/    merged metadata, NOSC, porewater gas, enzyme, CAMPER counts
  02_phyloseq/    phyloseq objects this script creates
  03_maaslin/     every Maaslin2 fit
  04_suppl_data/  Supplementary Data 1-18
  06_figures/     all main and supplementary figure PDFs, named as they are
                  cited: Figure_1 to Figure_6, Figure_S1 to Figure_S9
  08_network/     SpiecEasi fit, association matrix, linking tables, Figure 3

## Supplementary Data

01 environmental, porewater and annual CH4 flux mixed models
02 enzyme activity mixed models
03 metabolite feature responses to water table drawdown
04 metabolite feature responses to temperature
05 class-level competitive tests on the metabolite coefficients
06 MAG taxonomy and genome quality
```
